Picture a school official sitting at your kitchen table, red pen in hand, grading not just your child's test but your decision to homeschool at all. That is the direction Tennessee is headed if HB1729 becomes law.
HB1729 is being sold as a minor update to testing rules and a chance to add one more exam option, the Classic Learning Test (CLT). But behind the technical language lies a clear shift: more state control over home education and less trust in parents.
Here's what the bill really does. It expands mandatory standardized testing for homeschool students in grades 5, 7, and 9. Those test scores would no longer be just between parents and their children. HB1729 requires that results be sent to the local director of schools and the state board, feeding more data into government systems and inviting more scrutiny of families who have chosen a different educational path.
The bill also redefines what counts as "non‐proficient" with detailed cut scores and percentiles. If a child's performance falls below those rigid thresholds, parents are automatically pulled into mandated consultations with district officials and licensed teachers -- people who may never have met the student, but now gain leverage over what is deemed an "acceptable" homeschool education.
If the student still doesn't hit the state-approved numbers, HB1729 forces a second round of the same standardized test within a year. That happens regardless of whether the parents believe the test is appropriate, accurate, or aligned with their curriculum or their child's learning style. Home instruction, in effect, becomes a probationary program, subject to recurring state evaluation.
Most troubling, the bill authorizes the director of schools to order parents to enroll their child in a public, private, or church-related school if the student repeatedly underperforms and is not diagnosed with a learning disability. In other words, one official, using one narrow measurement, could overrule a family's educational choice.
That is a profound shift in who ultimately decides what is best for a child.
Standardized tests can be useful tools, but HB1729 turns them into gatekeepers of educational freedom. It assumes that a single test score on a few days out of a year should carry more weight than years of daily parental observation, tutoring, and instruction. It treats parents as suspects who must prove their competence to the state rather than as partners trusted to raise and educate their own children.
Yes, the bill does one positive thing: it recognizes the CLT, slightly expanding options for both public and homeschool students. But this small gain is chained to a larger expansion of regulatory burdens and surveillance. That is a bad trade for Tennessee families and for anyone who believes in limited government.
Homeschooling parents are already accountable -- to their children, to their own consciences, and ultimately to the same laws that protect every child from neglect or abuse. HB1729 layers on a new regime of testing, reporting, and potential coercion that undermines that accountability rather than improving it.
Lawmakers should reject HB1729, and citizens should tell them so. Call your representative, attend local meetings, and speak up: Tennessee does not need more centralized control over education. It needs more trust in families.

While the media has been hyper-focused on the redistricting fights, this case has seemingly flown under the radar -- even though its impact on voting and representation would be a larger swing than all the current redistricting efforts combined.
This decision could knock the last leg out from the Voting Rights Act (VRA), functionally ending a historic piece of legislation and setting our fight for fair representation back decades.
RUSH $35 or more right now to help protect what the VRA stands for and defend our fundamental right to vote >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=021126_2&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
@ariberman.bsky.social: SCOTUS decision killing what’s left of Voting Rights Act could cost Dems 19 House seats, eliminate every majority-minority district in South, eviscerate 14th/15th Amendments & fulfill John Roberts 40-year crusade against country’s most important civil rights law [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=021126_2&amount=25]
The impact shows how partisan this all is, Team. A complete dismantling of the Voting Rights Act -- a key civil rights law -- would only harm one political party and return parts of the country to a suppressive era we left behind sixty years ago.
During the oral arguments in Louisiana v. Callais , at least five conservative justices seemed ready to handicap the VRA so that it will no longer stop white majorities from locking racial minorities out of elected office through racial gerrymandering.
The consequences are simple to understand and grave for voter participation. The harder we make it to vote, the more politicians make voter participation feel worthless, the less people actually take part. Needless to say, the less people who participate, the less our democracy and our government looks like the people it's supposed to represent.

At issue in the case is Section 2 of the VRA, which requires that racial minorities have an equal opportunity to meaningfully participate in the electoral process. This provision has been used to strike down districting schemes and maps that prevented Black voters and other racial minorities from electing their preferred representatives. Since 1965, Section 2 has given people of color a seat at the table, from school boards to the halls of Congress. It appears this 60-year era is coming to an end.
We've said it before and will say it again, but it's been clear long before the MAGA movement that Chief Justice Roberts has seen the removal of the VRA as one of his top goals for his time on the Court. It appears he may be on the cusp of succeeding.
Striking down the last remnants of the Voting Rights Act is exactly why the Supreme Court held this case over from last year. Gutting Section 2 would take us backwards in time and allow racial gerrymandering to be a standard practice, silencing more voters. Just like the redistricting fights across the country, this is all about whether the party in power can choose their voters in order to stay in power in perpetuity.
We simply can't afford to go backwards like this. Will you chip in with $35 or more to help us fight back against these partisan efforts to silence voters? >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=021126_2&amount=35]

It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

subject: one year ago
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY DEB FOR NEW MEXICO**
body:
Since then, with your support, we have accomplished so much.

| | | [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/134?t=1&akid=7450%2E400544%2EYaqAYn)
---
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5112?refcode=jtk261-fr-nd&t=2&akid=7450%2E400544%2EYaqAYn)
Today marks a special milestone for our campaign, friend: **One year ago, I launched my** ** _[campaign for governor of New Mexico](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5112?refcode=jtk261-fr-nd&t=3&akid=7450%2E400544%2EYaqAYn)_****. Since then, with your support, we have accomplished so much:**
— On our very first day, in only 24 hours, we collected over **2,500 signatures** from New Mexicans nominating me for governor. We went on to gather thousands more, **filed to add my name to the ballot, and now, I am OFFICIALLY on the ballot to be the next governor of New Mexico.**
— We traveled to all 33 counties in New Mexico, visiting with local community members and breaking bread with New Mexican families from all walks of life. I've sat at kitchen tables and heard all about people's struggles and their hopes for the future.
— We grew this grassroots team to thousands of supporters from all across New Mexico who believe in our campaign and our mission to create a state where families can thrive.
— We supported New Mexico families at every step of the way. We delivered 676 meals to families relying on SNAP, picketed with workers for better pay, pushed for workforce training in middle schools, and delivered supplies to flood victims.
— We launched my vision: a New Mexico for New Mexicans: Strengthening education, lowering costs for families, expanding access to healthcare, and delivering real public safety rooted in prevention and trust. We’ll help kids read earlier, put more money back in people’s pockets, protect and expand the coverage families rely on, make New Mexico an energy titan, and stand up for New Mexicans so they can raise families and build a future here at home.
**_[None of this progress is possible without MASSIVE grassroots effort from supporters like you, friend.](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5112?refcode=jtk261-fr-nd&t=4&akid=7450%2E400544%2EYaqAYn)_** Hundreds of thousands of people have stepped up with donations to make sure this campaign has the resources it needs to win in November.
I'm in this race because New Mexicans deserve a governor who will fight for affordability, healthcare, public safety, and education. They deserve a governor who will strengthen our schools and protect our environment. **I'm ready to move us toward a future where everyone can thrive.**
**But with the GOP eyeing this seat, and now FIVE Republicans running against me, we need all hands on deck to ensure we have the resources to fight back against right-wing attacks and win in November.**
**_[This is the perfect opportunity to make your first donation to help power my campaign! Will you chip in $5 or even $10 right now so we can commemorate this milestone?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5112?refcode=jtk261-fr-nd&t=5&akid=7450%2E400544%2EYaqAYn)_**
| | [Donate](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5112?refcode=jtk261-fr-nd&t=6&akid=7450%2E400544%2EYaqAYn)
---
Thank you for your support,

Deb

| | | “An F.B.I. search warrant affidavit unsealed on Tuesday shows that a criminal investigation into 2020 election results in Fulton County, Ga., was **set off by a leading election denier in the Trump administration** and relied heavily on claims about ballots that have been widely debunked.”****
_—The New York Times_
---
We now have proof.
Two weeks ago, when Trump’s FBI raided an elections office in Fulton County, Georgia to seize ballots and records from 2020, it looked like an obvious attempt to recycle debunked claims about his decisive defeat — that could set the stage to interfere with future elections.
Now that’s in writing. In an affidavit.
The FBI’s newly unsealed search warrant affidavit is a laundry list of rehashed claims from the same election deniers whose 2020 conspiracy theories were investigated, litigated, and proven false.
What comes next? Take it from our co-founder and CEO, Lauren Groh-Wargo:
_“This is what happens when the same network that tried to overturn 2020 is handed federal power to invent crises, cook up fake ‘evidence,’ and send in the FBI —**their next step is to demand drastic changes to elections and remove voters from the rolls.** Trump has called on Republicans to ‘take over the voting’ and ‘nationalize’ elections, which is absolutely illegal, and Fulton County — where his FBI seized 2020 ballots — is where they are attempting to advance this first.”_

| | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

name: Texas Organizing Project
subject: RSVP NOW: We’d LOVE you to join us! / ¡Confirma tu asistencia ya! Nos encantaría que nos acompañes ❤️ ✨ 🎟️
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/PNG%202023%20TOP%20Newsletter%20Header.png]
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
FEB. 24 IN DALLAS:
TOP's Black History Month Symposium with Michael Harriot is approaching
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/TOP%20BLACK%20AF%20Black%20History%20Month%20event%20with%20Michael%20Harriot.jpg]
COMING SOON: TOP is excited to have Michael Harriot [https://www.michaelharriot.com/] , best-selling author of Black AF History [https://www.michaelharriot.com/poscasts] , join us later this month for an evening of connection, celebration, and building community power!
This event honoring the 100th anniversary of Black History Month and will be held February 24th at Friendship-West Baptist Church in Dallas , so mark your calendars and get your tickets. An RSVP is required to attend this event! [https://topblackhistorysymposium.rsvpify.com/]
https://topblackhistorysymposium.rsvpify.com/ [https://topblackhistorysymposium.rsvpify.com/]
Endorsing Texas fighters ready for this political moment
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Crockett%20and%20Hinojosa.jpg]
ENDORSEMENT TIME: TOP PAC announced last week endorsements for Congresswoman Jasmine Crockett [https://www.jasmineforus.com/] for U.S. Senate, as well as State Rep. Gina Hinojosa [https://ginafortexas.com/] for Texas Governor — two high-profile races that will determine the future of our state for years to come.
Congresswoman Crockett and Rep. Hinojosa are committed, knowledgeable, and proven fighters for working Texans who know we have to use every tool in our toolbox to resist and overcome Trump and Gov. Abbott's agenda that aims to weaken our Black and Latino communities. We're excited to roll up our sleeves and support their campaigns this election!
Early voting for the Texas Democratic Primary starts this coming Tuesday, February 17th, and runs through the 27th. Election Day is Tuesday, March 3. Make a plan to vote, and tell your friends, family, and neighbors to do the same
CHECK OUT TOP PAC's full list of endorsed candidates so far for the primary election. [https://organizetexas.org/about-top-pac/endorsements/]
THIS SATURDAY:
TOP healthcare community conversation in Houston
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/TOP%20hearts.jpg]
The attacks to healthcare access and affordability in Trump's second term so far have been no joke. From higher health insurance premium costs, to massive cuts to Medicaid, Texans of all walks of life are feeling the negative impacts.
Healthcare is a human right at TOP , and at this critical time with our healthcare system looking bleak, we want to hear from YOU -- members, supporters, and community members. Join at our next free community event in Houston, where you can grab lunch, weigh in on what real healthcare looks like to you, and discuss how we can fight for and win that in Texas.
Houston: Saturday, Feb. 14th, 11 - 1 p.m.
Contact Lucinda at ldavis@organizetexas.org [ldavis@organizetexas.org] to RSVP.
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfoc1OUiuz2TfuWAMFfFO2p2m3ti1xB9QGZzEjIya3BgLA9EA/viewform [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfoc1OUiuz2TfuWAMFfFO2p2m3ti1xB9QGZzEjIya3BgLA9EA/viewform]
MAKING HISTORY:
Congratulating a progressive champion and movement leader on her election victory
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Analilia%20Mejia.jpg]
MOVEMENT WIN: The Squad will soon have another member in their ranks, as Analilia Mejia [https://19thnews.org/2026/02/analilia-mejia-new-jersey-primary/] just pulled off an upset win in the special election primary for New Jersey's 11th Congressional District. This is grassroots people-power in action!
Analilia is Co-Executive Director of Popular Democracy [https://populardemocracy.org/] , of which TOP is a proud affiliate. For years, she’s organized communities, been on the frontlines for working families, and championed bold progressive policy solutions. TOP congratulates Congresswoman-elect Mejia on her amazing win!
TRUMP TRACKER:
He's made the housing crisis worse
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/housing%20crisis.jpg]
We're back with another edition of our Trump Tracker, where we cut through the noise and keep our eyes on the prize [https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/blog/misinformation-desk/202511/critical-ignoring-a-strategy-for-information-overload] for what really matters to our families and communities. This week, we're looking at housing , and just how much the president is faltering and talking out of both sides of his mouth on the issue.
This headline sums it up well: Voters are worried about the cost of housing. But Trump wants home prices to keep climbing. [https://apnews.com/article/trump-housing-mortgage-midterm-elections-prices-affordability-6bda9c1260550990bc819bcb6f1402cf]
Through his words and policies (don't forget about those awful tariffs), the president has made life more difficult for aspiring home-owners and renters alike. Trump's gutting of federal housing assistance programs has further hurt working families living paycheck-to-paycheck ( this is all intentional and was outlined in Project 2025 [https://shelterforce.org/2024/09/26/how-project-2025-would-dismantle-hud/] ). And this is all while he demonizes people experiencing homelessness.
What's become more clear is that Trump's search for short-term housing market fixes isn't going to save him or any of us. And MAGA deregulation and short-sightedness is only making matters worse. [https://48hills.org/2026/01/new-study-shows-that-deregulation-is-not-the-answer-to-the-affordable-housing-crisis/]
Español
24 DE FEB. EN DALLAS:
Se acerca el Simposio del Mes de la Historia Negra
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/TOP%20BLACK%20AF%20Black%20History%20Month%20event%20with%20Michael%20Harriot.jpg]
PRÓXIMAMENTE: TOP se complace en invitar a Michael Harriot [https://www.michaelharriot.com/] , autor de superventas de Black AF History [https://www.michaelharriot.com/poscasts] , a finales de este mes para una noche de conexión, celebración y fortalecimiento comunitario.
Este evento, que conmemora el centenario del Mes de la Historia Negra, se celebrará el 24 de febrero en la Iglesia Bautista Friendship-West de Dallas . ¡Agenden sus entradas! ¡Se requiere confirmación de asistencia! [https://topblackhistorysymposium.rsvpify.com/]
https://topblackhistorysymposium.rsvpify.com/ [https://topblackhistorysymposium.rsvpify.com/]
Respaldando a las luchadoras de Texas que están listos para este momento político
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Crockett%20and%20Hinojosa.jpg]
¡LLEGADA LA HORA DE LOS RESPALDOS POLÍTICOS!: TOP PAC anunció la semana pasada el apoyo a la congresista Jasmine Crockett [https://www.jasmineforus.com/] para el Senado de los Estados Unidos, así como a la representante estatal Gina Hinojosa [https://ginafortexas.com/] para gobernadora de Texas: dos contiendas de alto perfil que determinarán el futuro de nuestro estado en los próximos años.
La congresista Crockett y la representante Hinojosa son líderes comprometidas, preparadas y luchadoras comprobadas por las y los trabajadores de Texas. Ellas saben que debemos usar todas las herramientas a nuestro alcance para resistir y superar la agenda de Trump y del gobernador Abbott que busca debilitar a nuestras comunidades negras y latinas. ¡Estamos listas y listos para arremangarnos y apoyar sus campañas en esta elección!
La votación anticipada para la Primaria Demócrata de Texas comienza este martes 17 de febrero y continúa hasta el 27 de febrero. El Día de la Elección es el martes 3 de marzo. ¡Planifique su votación y dígales a sus amigos, familiares y vecinos que hagan lo mismo!
CONSULTE la lista completa de candidatos respaldados por TOP PAC para las elecciones primarias. [https://organizetexas.org/about-top-pac/endorsements/]
ESTE SÁBADO: Conversación comunitaria sobre atención médica en Houston
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/TOP%20hearts.jpg]
Los ataques al acceso y la asequibilidad de la atención médica en el segundo mandato de Trump hasta ahora no han sido ninguna broma. Desde el aumento en el costo de las primas de los seguros médicos hasta los recortes masivos a Medicaid, los tejanos de todos los ámbitos están sintiendo los impactos negativos.
En TOP, la atención médica es un derecho humano , y en este momento crítico con nuestro sistema de salud en declive, queremos escuchar de USTEDES: miembros, simpatizantes y miembros de la comunidad. Únase a nuestros próximos eventos comunitarios gratuitos en Houston, donde podrá almorzar, opinar sobre cómo ve la atención médica real para usted y discutir cómo podemos luchar por ello y lograrlo en Texas.
Houston: Sábado, 14 de febrero, 11 - 1 p.m.
Contacte a Lucinda en ldavis@organizetexas.org [ldavis@organizetexas.org] para confirmar su asistencia.
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf1bY_DlK7WwjhHEWsdJhb8yQSqAUdL3z_EEH_QepPF2HeAEw/viewform [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf1bY_DlK7WwjhHEWsdJhb8yQSqAUdL3z_EEH_QepPF2HeAEw/viewform]
HACIENDO HISTORIA:
Felicitaciones a una campeona progresista y líder del movimiento por su victoria electoral
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Analilia%20Mejia.jpg]
VICTORIA DEL MOVIMIENTO: El Escuadrón pronto tendrá otra integrante en sus filas, ya que Analilia Mejía [https://19thnews.org/2026/02/analilia-mejia-new-jersey-primary/] acaba de lograr una impresionante victoria en las primarias especiales para el 11.o Distrito Congresional de Nueva Jersey. ¡Esto es poder popular de base en acción!
Analilia es codirectora ejecutiva de Popular Democracy [https://populardemocracy.org/] , organización de la cual TOP es una orgullosa afiliada. Durante años, ha organizado comunidades, ha estado al frente de las familias trabajadoras y ha defendido soluciones políticas progresistas y audaces. ¡TOP felicita a la congresista electa Mejía por su asombrosa victoria!
RASTREADOR DE TRUMP:
Ha empeorado la crisis de la vivienda
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/housing%20crisis.jpg]
Regresamos con otra edición de nuestro Rastreador de Trump , donde dejamos de lado el ruido y nos centramos en lo que realmente importa [https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/blog/misinformation-desk/202511/critical-ignoring-a-strategy-for-information-overload] a nuestras familias y comunidades. Esta semana analizamos el tema de la vivienda y cómo el presidente está fallando y diciendo una cosa y otra sobre este asunto.
Este titular lo resume bien: Los votantes están preocupados por el costo de la vivienda. Pero Trump quiere que los precios de las viviendas sigan subiendo. [https://apnews.com/article/trump-housing-mortgage-midterm-elections-prices-affordability-6bda9c1260550990bc819bcb6f1402cf]
Con sus palabras y políticas (sin olvidar esos terribles aranceles), el presidente ha dificultado la vida tanto a quienes aspiran a ser propietarios como a quienes alquilan. El desmantelamiento de los programas federales de asistencia para la vivienda por parte de Trump ha perjudicado aún más a las familias trabajadoras que viven al día ( todo esto es intencional y se describió en el Proyecto 2025 [https://shelterforce.org/2024/09/26/how-project-2025-would-dismantle-hud/] ). Y todo esto mientras demoniza a las personas sin hogar.
Cada vez queda más claro que la búsqueda de soluciones rápidas y a corto plazo para el mercado de vivienda no lo salvará a él ni a ninguno de nosotros. Y la desregulación impulsada por MAGA, junto con su visión a corto plazo, solo está empeorando la situación. [https://48hills.org/2026/01/new-study-shows-that-deregulation-is-not-the-answer-to-the-affordable-housing-crisis/]

subject: This is not the moment to drift
body:
Right now, women facing unplanned pregnancies are being told to decide quickly.

| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z90hdo6o995jeq71ak8hodacmccs1l870g4k17e8_rp22sh2s8i6epr0c3ie2o31c5h2bs)
---
Advocate for Life, This is not the moment to drift. This is the moment to act. Right now, women facing unplanned pregnancies are being told to decide quickly. They’re being assured that abortion is the fastest way to make fear, pressure, and uncertainty go away. In too many cases, that decision is pushed through before a mother has had the chance to see her baby or hear the heartbeat—something abortion providers will never show her. Once that moment passes, it cannot be undone. That is why PreBorn! exists: to step into that narrow window of time with compassion, truth, and hope. When a mother comes to one of our PreBorn! Network Clinics, she is met with compassion instead of pressure. She is offered a free ultrasound and given the chance to see the life growing inside her and hear the heartbeat that changes everything. That moment interrupts the rush of panic and allows truth to break through fear. [**And more than 80% of the time, when a mother sees her baby and hears their heartbeat, she chooses life.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zn4jfvc2luoqc3moc9ocqc3ln8k46b232go9k9ko_rp22sh2s8i6epr0c3ie2o31c5h2bs) But what we offer is not only an ultrasound. We stay with her. We support her so she can confidently choose life for her baby. And we share the gospel of Jesus Christ because the deepest need in that room is not just clarity, but hope that lasts beyond the crisis—the kind of hope only Jesus can give. In a month when the world talks a lot about love, this is how we get to show it in a way that truly matters. Our goal is clear: fund 11,000 ultrasounds by February 28. Each ultrasound costs $28, and each one represents a mother receiving the truth in time—before an irreversible decision is made.
---
* $28 provides 1 ultrasound
* $56 provides 2 ultrasounds
* $140 provides 5 ultrasounds
* $280 provides 10 ultrasounds

---
Together, we are making sure truth shows up in time, compassion meets panic, and hope is offered where it’s needed most.
---
[**Give One Ultrasound >>**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zbo029q6k3pcqsgekp19dalo5gm0l2863pl718b0_rp22sh2s8i6epr0c3ie2o31c5h2bs)

Thank you for standing with us in this work and for caring deeply about mothers, babies, and the eternal impact of the gospel. With confidence and gratitude, The PreBorn! Team

The streets of Chicago feel right different now.
| | | | | [](https://e96gjzhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001OtStWeQjWolVZl9bqbzxtMKRiyL377KdxQprB-b-DmxOcrZ53ZiWUOSVe0-eZrprBB0VLYPIxuWeKvfq56DLHi9U_n-AsQwh_GoX-ya1cDJ_kFWjbNeSgzXOe1ctXPImDbG5OerYU3n4i8JHsa6fnOffnqufod3v9KkpamHRhGFlnhqmEjGPY6_Xs8zjXQ6MTSgyVwCL743cldYKt3X3qE3V4TKiV7dM&c=RvBxvKp9Qf3UMYOqcq9iSCJzrMKYCJBTkr1beu3HCiIdo8Y0iKg1Tw==&ch=JK5cHPAWK7aOc7yLdRbRpXImUhTqNDHLBccnO4WchEyebDHm-6NsfQ==)

Peter,
The streets of Chicago feel different right now.
Unmarked vans prowl at night--masked ICE agents snatching neighbors in silence. Protesters are dragged across pavement by masked federal agents whose names are hidden behind black tape. Soldiers march through city intersections meant for kids on bikes and buses to work.
At food banks across America, recently laid off workers wait in line. Families scrape together meals as grocery prices skyrocket.
Children fall asleep hungry. Seniors cut their pills in half, praying it's enough to last the week.
This is Trump's America--and it's only been 12 months.
But in November, there was a beacon of hope.
Across the country, Democrats won landslide victories. Not the kind propped up by corporate donors or political dynasties--but led by a new generation of Democrats, unfazed by Trump's fascist threats, determined to defend democracy and deliver for the people suffering most.

---
| | [](https://e96gjzhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001OtStWeQjWolVZl9bqbzxtMKRiyL377KdxQprB-b-DmxOcrZ53ZiWUOSVe0-eZrprBB0VLYPIxuWeKvfq56DLHi9U_n-AsQwh_GoX-ya1cDJ_kFWjbNeSgzXOe1ctXPImDbG5OerYU3n4i8JHsa6fnOffnqufod3v9KkpamHRhGFlnhqmEjGPY6_Xs8zjXQ6MTSgyVwCL742TKJIhTV4cGFy3AaSLms80&c=RvBxvKp9Qf3UMYOqcq9iSCJzrMKYCJBTkr1beu3HCiIdo8Y0iKg1Tw==&ch=JK5cHPAWK7aOc7yLdRbRpXImUhTqNDHLBccnO4WchEyebDHm-6NsfQ==)
---
|
They came from every faith, every color, every corner of America--a generation forged in crisis but united in purpose. And together, they dominated Republicans from coast to coast, determined to rebuild this nation for the working class.
I saw that energy firsthand when I worked for Zohran Mamdani during the primary in New York City. The establishment spent millions trying to destroy our movement--but our campaign was powered by people, and we won anyway.
That same exact spirit brought me home to Chicago to work for Bushra Amiwala.
And I'm seeing it again. The same fire. The same defiance. The same hope.
Bushra's campaign isn't fueled by big donors--it's powered by neighbors, students, and working people who believe in a better future for America. While establishment campaigns write checks, Bushra is building a movement.
When ICE began terrorizing our neighbors, Bushra stood by their side even in the face of tear gas and rubber bullets. When AIPAC poured hundreds of thousands into our opponent's campaign, Bushra outraised them with grassroots donations from ordinary people. And when others paid canvassers to collect signatures, our entirely volunteer-led team hit the streets--door by door, block by block--until we got Bushra on the ballot.
This is what democracy looks like in the hands of a new generation.
Now we need to keep building. The stakes are too high to let up for even a day. clean_body: The streets of Chicago feel right different now. | | | | | == | Peter, The streets of Chicago feel different right now. Unmarked vans prowl at night--masked ICE agents snatching neighbors in silence. Protesters are dragged across pavement by masked federal agents whose names are hidden behind black tape. Soldiers march through city intersections meant for kids on bikes and buses to work. At food banks across America, recently laid off workers wait in line. Families scrape together meals as grocery prices skyrocket. Children fall asleep hungry. Seniors cut their pills in half, praying it's enough to last the week. This is Trump's America--and it's only been 12 months. But in November, there was a beacon of hope. Across the country, Democrats won landslide victories. Not the kind propped up by corporate donors or political dynasties--but led by a new generation of Democrats, unfazed by Trump's fascist threats, determined to defend democracy and deliver for the people suffering most. | | == | They came from every faith, every color, every corner of America--a generation forged in crisis but united in purpose. And together, they dominated Republicans from coast to coast, determined to rebuild this nation for the working class. I saw that energy firsthand when I worked for Zohran Mamdani during the primary in New York City. The establishment spent millions trying to destroy our movement--but our campaign was powered by people, and we won anyway. That same exact spirit brought me home to Chicago to work for Bushra Amiwala. And I'm seeing it again. The same fire. The same defiance. The same hope. Bushra's campaign isn't fueled by big donors--it's powered by neighbors, students, and working people who believe in a better future for America. While establishment campaigns write checks, Bushra is building a movement. When ICE began terrorizing our neighbors, Bushra stood by their side even in the face of tear gas and rubber bullets. When AIPAC poured hundreds of thousands into our opponent's campaign, Bushra outraised them with grassroots donations from ordinary people. And when others paid canvassers to collect signatures, our entirely volunteer-led team hit the streets--door by door, block by block--until we got Bushra on the ballot. This is what democracy looks like in the hands of a new generation. Now we need to keep building. The stakes are too high to let up for even a day. ## Canada Reels From Mass School Shooting
A transgender 18-year-old former student [killed eight people and wounded](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2OnTAQBeCngc7IfxgoXKSh27Qp0WAP144GG9neRfftI7KPsO2MdHS-8-dj-4BIMb1-w4m2HXlLeFfC1rBsDhJ4qC7kTDXk3GJ6fV4h0ia5NIxLJuTmIdJ70723B6JE1aMV08TnRatF9cGCUaPeDecKjBkXPxqFjo8cDy8WD3sf7ZPGpZBCcKPEsOOsARxMfpHAQXSao48tl-FvjqkFPOidv7AMLp892dDaVTv1q5NrJ9f7voe0u0fx_J9LLuQ7uX5rOrke0IDozWrIje0ltlgDc5k-zz0C--Yyj-BZxQsKNGSUHbSYEysugRxnPeu-WH_dkShWM3Wav06I9L9S-9GOX1b-CwAA__92IImb) roughly 25 others in one of Canada's deadliest mass shootings, police said, striking a small British Columbia town of about 2,400 people. Royal Canadian Mounted Police identified the shooter on Wednesday as Jesse Van Rootselaar, who fatally shot a 39-year-old woman believed to be his mother and an 11-year-old stepbrother at home before storming [Tumbler Ridge Secondary School](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2OgzAQRk9jOkf2QPgpXGzjLttuiQY8gFfGg2wnEbdfkSts_UlP33s_j_GBPvi4fuNOpiw8RnrnQKVQGmeM6DDPG3PIG3PxcX0emw8jKGilAqlhdOjDOTaVMwsRUF2R0V2n-qGph7razL3T96lFV6tmGibooaXO0dwv8-BoxqXy5qIp0KC1amt9m6hvEGfs3ACoUItGkfOF0-2XfSwbLeHkF6XbzHsVzFbKkUX9JcAKsPE8OJdrEmAvsACrQIDVWoB9cwpOXooCbHnuU6Akk3cryR1zlh9LStI7JzFL3cuTMEkOTr4wysRcMgXEJMBWybjj7UPwue1Eo9Ydffh8Kv8K-TLwFwAA___1KIfy), where more were killed. The school victims included five students, ages 12 to 13, and a female teacher. Police said they had visited the family home multiple times over mental health concerns and had previously seized firearms. ## FAA Closing of El Paso Airspace Quickly Reversed

**PRESS RELEASE**

**Justin Story Backs SAVE Act to Protect Election Integrity** __

**“The right to vote is sacred and protecting it is essential to preserving our Republic. The SAVE Act simply affirms what Americans already believe: federal elections should be decided by American citizens, and only American citizens.” - Justin Story**
---
|
---
| | February 12, 2026Contact: [Justin@VoteJustinStory.com](mailto:justin@votejustinstory.com?subject=&body=)
---
| |

**ST. CLOUD, FL** — Justin Story, candidate for Congress in Florida’s 9th Congressional District, today announced his strong support for the Safeguard American Voter Eligibility (SAVE) Act, commonsense legislation that reinforces existing federal law by ensuring that only U.S. citizens are allowed to vote in federal elections.“The right to vote is sacred and protecting it is essential to preserving our Republic. The SAVE Act simply affirms what Americans already believe: federal elections should be decided by American citizens, and only American citizens.”Federal law already prohibits non-citizens from voting in federal elections, but enforcement and verification standards remain inconsistent across states. The SAVE Act strengthens safeguards by requiring proof of citizenship for voter registration in federal elections, closing loopholes that undermine public confidence in the electoral system.As a candidate for Congress, Story has made election integrity, border security, and adherence to the rule of law central pillars of his campaign. He believes secure elections protect the voices of lawful voters, particularly working families who want transparency, fairness, and accountability from their government.“Florida has led the way in strengthening election security, and Washington should follow that example. I will always stand for lawful elections, secure borders, and policies that put American citizens first.”Justin Story is running to represent Florida’s 9th Congressional District and is committed to defending constitutional freedoms, restoring accountability in Washington, and putting the interests of Florida families ahead of special interests. For learn more about Justin and his campaign, visit [VoteJustinStory.com](https://us.list-manage.com/Yc6bvl0CrbP?e=90ad5fc3c5&c2id=d60c3f7cebee07fc4dcb3011da999329) or contact [justin@votejustinstory.com](mailto:justin@votejustinstory.com?subject=&body=). ###

[State Auditor Launch Video](http://email.mg.drscottjensen.com/c/eJwcj72uGyEQRp9maSxWMAwwFBQp4hSRohTpo-FvTbQ_lhfn6r79ld19n3SKc_hZet1z_dtLDC54kY99cB6vr21JDTVKDz5LbFQlW24ysWGdqHAAFiW2EsA0UaP2XlHwzllxi7ZYTmi1a6FxYjY5W1UaaQq2ZrSiR1DgFGjQoLTCWSV02lFAJMzk0oRqW-byOPMxxr-6n3Wf87GJNd7GuJ-T-TbBdYLr5_EczznVCa7Lj_HnJ_1e-i8SWz1PXt5htbJF45tUCUAipCyTMSh1ySFZ4IZE4ngsL5YMFOc8yAYNJJINklQD6QLpzLa0mox4xHL_6OvaT-cnVMvGfX27jfj9tS_7MS6N-1qL-B_hKwAA__-1l2qi)

For me, public service has never been about titles - it has always been about responsibility. My decision reflects where I believe my experience and training are best used to serve Minnesota at this critical time. I confidently exit the Governor’s race knowing that one of the remaining candidates vying to become the next Governor of Minnesota will be well-positioned to win the office in November.

Over the last several months, I’ve enjoyed meeting and speaking with folks across our state. Whether visiting with a farmer or an attorney, a law enforcement officer or a teacher, a parent or a college student, a business owner or a corporate CEO, the topic that consistently comes up is **_FRAUD_**. The level of resentment over stolen taxpayer dollars is staggering! When public funds are misused and oversight appears inconsistent, confidence in government suffers.

**Minnesota is hurting. Restoring trust requires strong, independent financial oversight.
**
This is why I am turning my attention to the State Auditor’s office. It is vital to elect a candidate with the experience and expertise to protect taxpayer dollars, strengthen financial oversight, and restore confidence in how public funds are managed.

Throughout my career, I’ve served in a multitude of positions that provide me with a breadth of knowledge and experience centered on financial accountability and governance:

* Chairman of the **audit section** of a billion-dollar bank for 10+ years
* Board of Directors for multiple banks since 1987
* Chair of the Waconia School Board
* Owner and operator of numerous businesses
* Taught at the U of M Medical School for 30 years
* Served in the Minnesota Senate (2017-2021)

**
I look forward to reviving lawful, efficient, and transparent stewardship of your tax dollars. Together, we will restore Minnesota to be the bright shining Star of the North!

## El Paso Airspace Closed Before Reopening
The Federal Aviation Administration [closed the airspace](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u4yAQhZ_G7oiGMTamoNgm3d12S2vsGRIkHCxA-Xn7lfMKtzw60qfznX8_yw_FFB-3v7SLb--Ql4e8apLWpCySDqqZYqkHbVIkH_IQ3mNdEHBSgErjwhTTZzE9-xXY6V68thZmZ-0I_d1PDuaJg1sNuVHTankeaDS8GqsRNfTRnzBAjRoB0V0Gs26DlYk2HYIbuDMgHFsul3aXJm-qIX3yU8ply3uf_L21o3bDnw6vHV7pOAXO6gylxS1Jh9dApCSp00d9GYpiUV8vtaVchZUO1pqVA5spjG6eQgCxAAMHC24j6ovn4xVTinWynYHbTjF9N7TfPff0-D8AAP__w4yBug) over El Paso late Tuesday for "special security reasons" before reopening it yesterday morning, assuring the public there was "no threat to commercial aviation." The initial order halted all flights into and out of El Paso International Airport for 10 days. U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy later [explained](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOszAQBOCnMR3IXgiOCxd_Q5e_vRIt9hIsLdiyrZC8_Ym7R7h-NKNvvh7zAwOH4_kfd7L1vcb5oLMw1Up5Jk5YIoZcEjrKFBMd5PdQZpAwthJaBbPHwJ95aLxdpDeqIau0lnej9U02myVzl6YnMGbQsKh11WY092EBB3AzSE2wV5kEBQokgOn6YXG9phGdWlfTezFI8qHG3NWNKr2xrPyJL8qdi3vDdqs1FdH_EzAJmM7z7PZPwQOPGo8Qr5CA6VIJmDg6ZAET5hock4CJuL2QLYbc_gpLC6ofRgOmS1tqsvXpDMyhjFoM8rlj4J_l-re_Xha-AwAA__9Bz39f) the closure was prompted by a "cartel drone incursion" and that the "threat has been neutralized." However, several unnamed sources said the closure was caused by a lack of communication between the Pentagon and the FAA over [military testing](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDHOozAQRk8D3SAzEDsULrahy7ZbosEeB0sGI9sJ4fYrov8Gf_ekkZ7mff8e04N88NvzL62sy8fFaeMjBy6F08RhpxzJp7yT4cRx543t6vOEAiUIhBYnSz6cU19bPQs7tDXrVilxH5S6iXrRgyVpjXKzVIpukuZOoetY9o5cN5Osvb5kAltsUSAOTdfPplMsybTODZ2tesHWl5iasnDhD2UXzvjm1Ji41kEvpey56v5UOFY4HsfRbLO5Kq57heOFFY6vDD_kgn8uJQMHuPqAfNpjKvB1w0KhsIVWgKUzQ2bzSr6ckJhy3DI4IkhmI7zd-0HVSdv98CH4LFXVi-dKPnwfK7-b863xfwAAAP__XmiMtA) of anti-drone technology. El Paso Mayor Renard Johnson [called](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFuwyAQxvGnwRsRHE6AgaGLt3TtaF3gHKNiYwFN4j595Up9gs4n_U-_7-M6XjGmuN7fcSHXXlMeV3rWRK1RGSltWDPGUjf0VChvtFJYYh1BwIUL4BLGgDHtY98FdxPByo6c1FoYq_VZdLOT0mhlDfZBmDP2QlsgQ8IqY70y6LvojpgACRIEgD2p_uaVpgt6OU1WBdYLCrHlcmozNXphndKeH1ROPi9dcnNrW2XqjcHAYPic8qs9jhOD4bAwGFL2mBgMlPgB4gvuuXBfYos-flPlEyI_ivzPyuv81UJ-rl1xYXvGlGK9aNaL-4Ix_T5u_5vr4eAnAAD__zUngM0) the temporary flight restriction an "unnecessary decision" that caused "chaos and confusion.” U.S. Rep. Veronica Escobar said the FAA "owes the community and the country an explanation as to why this happened," [adding](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDHOozAQRk9jOiN7IBgKF9u4y7ZbogEPwVqDkT0Jye1XRNoT_PUnfe_p_bmPdwwx7I_fuJHl95LGnc4SiZnySPHAkjDkcuBMmdJBO_ktlBEUdFKB1DB6DPEztpW3k_KDrshqY1Q_GHNT1WqHjrRRAL7v28bfpm7yBn3b6J6oJ91UwV5nCjRoUABD3bTT3BjqcNbLMjRetIp84JRrXonpjWWJn_SiXM9pq6JdmY8iml8CnAB3nmf9tyBfowA3PUvYqRQB7sIIcAoEOK0FOF5JRmQqLBdEGcPCRTJtR8qYP3KOqTwzybTI_wnkhZUU5dVFfl0EuCpbf5whxlA6I1r12DDErxz_LOnLwr8AAAD__yLTi6E) that what's been shared publicly "does not add up." name: With Honor Action
subject: Veteran Lawmakers Lead the Fight to Fund AmeriCorps 🇺🇸
body:
National service champions in Congress end funding uncertainty for AmeriCorps by passing $1.2 billion in funding for national service programs.

| | | | | [|
---](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=33893c2adc&e=33f53a5b1a)
| | | | |
---
| | Hi Peter,
After nearly a year of uncertainty, Congress has passed a funding bill for AmeriCorps that delivers nearly [**$1.3 billion**](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=b8bb784c7a&e=33f53a5b1a) for national service programs. This bipartisan win, led by For Country Caucus members Reps. Chrissy Houlahan and Don Bacon, Rep. Brian Fitzpatrick, and Senators Chris Coons and Bill Cassidy, brings much-needed stability to the organizations and communities that rely on AmeriCorps service members to meet urgent local needs.
Watch Rep. Chrissy Houlahan’s remarks from our event marking the 5th anniversary of the National Service Commission’s report.
---
[|
---](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=c063efd7f5&e=33f53a5b1a)
|
---
| |
# With Honor Action Submits Statement in Support of Veterans Employment & Suicide Prevention Legislation

With Honor Action recently submitted a Statement for the Record for a hearing held by the House Veterans Affairs Committee in support of [H.R. 4105](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=00c63600b9&e=33f53a5b1a), _Veterans Energy Transition (VET) Act of 2025_ , and [H.R. 2878](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=dba89b442f&e=33f53a5b1a), _Daniel J. Harvey, Jr. and Adam Lambert Improving Servicemember Transition to Reduce Veteran Suicide Act_. You can read our full statement [here](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=80b973bf2b&e=33f53a5b1a) and hear remarks from bill leaders below.
---
| | | | | | | | | | [|
---](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=8a30351351&e=33f53a5b1a)
| | | **The VET Act** , co-led by For Country Caucus members Rep. Jen Kiggans and Chrissy Houlahan, incentivizes advanced manufacturing and energy companies to hire and train veterans and military spouses.
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | **The Daniel J. Harvey, Jr. and Adam Lambert Improving Servicemember Transition to Reduce Veteran Suicide Act** , led by current Air National Guardsman Rep. Zach Nunn,**** expands access to resources on mental health assistance to separating service members and veterans during their transition to civilian life.
---
| [|
---](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=dc1b2903d0&e=33f53a5b1a)
|
---

# Connect with us at the Munich Security Conference

For the second consecutive year, With Honor Action will be joining global leaders at the Munich Security Conference to advance bipartisan dialogue on global security and the challenges shaping U.S. national security. We look forward to connecting with partners and colleagues in Munich—please reach out if you’ll be attending.

name: Karl for Congress
subject: "The World Is In Peril"
body:
[](https://karlforcongress.us/updates/6e4bc01c/)
---
Many researchers are quitting their positions at top AI companies and warning that this technology is growing [too fast and with no safeguards](https://link.karlforcongress.us/698dc786/ "AI researchers are sounding the alarm on their way out the door "). It's also been reported that [OpenAI has reassigned members of its "Mission Alignment" team](https://link.karlforcongress.us/698dc8a5/ "Exclusive: OpenAI disbanded its mission alignment team") that was charged with ensuring AI benefits all of humanity. This shows a shifting focus to commercialization over safety. We are heading down a road where trillion-dollar companies are pumping obscene amounts of cash into development while only paying lip service to safety concerns. This should be setting off alarm bells in Congress, but instead they get bogged down in [surface-level debates about deepfakes](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/congress/house-passes-bipartisan-bill-combat-explicit-deepfakes-trump-rcna203316 "House passes bipartisan bill to combat explicit deepfakes, sending it to Trump to sign into law") while ignoring the structural risks of AI. Not only have they been silent on the issues that matter, AI companies have [ramped up donations to the tune of $100 million](https://link.karlforcongress.us/698dca22/ "How allies of AI are ramping up their political donations for the midterms ") to candidates they deem AI-friendly. This will ensure Congress continues to sidestep regulating AI. Our only bulwark against the tech oligarchs is being bought and paid for! This is why I'm running for Congress. We desperately need leadership to deal with emerging and advanced technologies. There is no aspect of society that this technology will not touch, and as a scientist, I know that any policy debate that ignores AI's role is political malpractice. Congress cannot continue to have a hands-off approach as the most transformative technology in human history establishes itself in the substrate of society, driven by companies that see our safety as secondary. Our window is closing to ensure this technology is properly regulated. We need leadership that understands the tech, not just the campaign checks.

# **Disturbing photo shows transgender gunman gleefully gripping rifle**
Jesse Van Rootselaar, 18, who began identifying as female at age 12, killed his mother Jennifer and brother Emmett at their home **[before opening fire in the library at Tumbler Ridge Secondary School,](https://substack.com/redirect/c5637373-8e6c-4c6b-8427-262cd7879816?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** killing a female teacher and five students aged 13-17, then taking his own life. Photos show the teen happily gripping a rifle alongside somber family photos.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c5637373-8e6c-4c6b-8427-262cd7879816?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Why it matters:** Van Rootselaar had a documented history of mental health issues -- he stopped attending school at age 14, was once apprehended for assessment under Canada's mental health act, and had firearms seized from his home during mental health checks before the gun owner successfully petitioned to have them returned. Jennifer did not have a valid firearms license at the time of her death.
* **The victims:** Twelve-year-old Maya Gebala was shot in the head and neck and doctors warned her mother she "wouldn't make the night," with her mother Cia Edmonds saying "our baby needs a miracle." Twenty-five people were injured in total, and a parent whose son attends the school said his child is now "afraid to go back to school" after knowing Van Rootselaar personally and playing sports with his sister.
* **The response:** Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney suspended planned trips to Halifax and the Munich Security Conference, saying he was "devastated" and joined "Canadians in grieving with those whose lives have been changed irreversibly." British Columbia Premier David Eby called it an "unimaginable tragedy" and said the community of Tumbler Ridge -- a small mountain town of 2,400 -- has been left shattered, with those who knew Van Rootselaar describing him as a "quiet kid" often seen "sitting by himself in the corner."

# **Mysterious neighborhood dog leads police to missing 3-year-old locked in car**
A collie mix in Louisville, Kentucky became an unlikely hero on January 7 when he persistently barked at Louisville Metropolitan Police officers searching for a missing 3-year-old boy, **[refusing to relent until they followed him directly to the child,](https://substack.com/redirect/5658c5e1-7289-4cae-b78c-7ac95725b443?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** who was found locked inside a car in a nearby garage.

Thompson went into "dad mode," instructing the boy on how to unlock the door until he could pull it open -- at which point the child "jumped from the car, bear hugged my neck, and wouldn't let go."

The collie turned out to be a well-known neighborhood fixture in the Okolona area, with local resident Sean Calloway introducing the dog to cameras and declaring him a hero -- prompting officers to celebrate by petting the dog and one cheering "Lassie found him."

## **Democrat Rep. Ted Lieu uses fabricated Epstein document to accuse Trump of sex trafficking at Bondi hearing**
Democratic Rep. Ted Lieu **[accuse President Trump of involvement in Jeffrey Epstein's sex trafficking operation](https://substack.com/redirect/a8a47bba-2746-447c-99c2-401b6216a4f0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** during Wednesday's House Judiciary hearing with Attorney General Pam Bondi, citing a witness statement claiming a limo driver overheard Trump speaking with Epstein about alleged crimes and met a girl who said she was "raped by Donald Trump and Jeffrey Epstein."
Lieu then accused Bondi of lying under oath for saying there is "no evidence of a crime" pertaining to the case. Bondi immediately fired back: "Don't you ever accuse me of a crime!"
[](https://substack.com/redirect/b88906ef-ee21-4bd5-862c-08667091456e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **The problem:** The document Lieu cited was entirely fabricated. The DOJ explicitly warned upon releasing the latest Epstein files that "this production may include fake or falsely submitted images, documents or videos" and that "some of the documents contain untrue and sensationalist claims against President Trump that were submitted to the FBI right before the 2020 election." The specific tip Lieu referenced also accused Hillary Clinton of orchestrating the Oklahoma City bombing in the same document.
* **Why it matters:** The incident is the latest example of Democrats seizing on unverified Epstein documents to attack Trump, despite the DOJ's clear warning that fabricated materials were included in the document dump. The DOJ noted that the claims "are unfounded and false, and if they have a shred of credibility, they certainly would have been weaponized against President Trump already."

# **Federal judge releases four illegal immigrants convicted of murder and child sex crimes from ICE custody**
A federal judge in Louisiana, Obama appointee John deGravelles, **[ordered the release of four illegal immigrants with violent criminal histories](https://substack.com/redirect/83860fa8-29ab-4913-be23-cfd2dd32a7af?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** from ICE custody on February 6, including individuals convicted of homicide, sexual exploitation of a minor, kidnapping, aggravated assault, and drug trafficking -- all of whom had existing deportation orders.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/83860fa8-29ab-4913-be23-cfd2dd32a7af?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Who was released:** The four men include Ibrahim Ali Mohammed, an Ethiopian citizen convicted of sexual exploitation of a minor with a 2024 deportation order; Luis Gaston-Sanchez, a Cuban national convicted of homicide and assault with a 2001 deportation order; Ricardo Blanco Chomat, also Cuban, convicted of homicide, kidnapping, and cocaine sales with a 2002 deportation order; and Francisco Rodriguez-Romero, convicted of homicide and weapons offenses with a 1995 deportation order.
* **What the government said:** DHS Assistant Secretary Tricia McLaughlin called the releases "inexcusably reckless," saying "the ramifications will only be the continued rape, murder, assault, and robbery of more American victims." She vowed that "if an immigration judge finds an illegal alien has no right to be in this country, we are going to remove them. Period." The Trump administration expanded ICE detention space at Louisiana State Penitentiary in September 2025 to house criminal illegal immigrants arrested by ICE.

Mysterious neighborhood dog leads police to missing 3-year-old locked in car A collie mix in Louisville, Kentucky became an unlikely hero on January 7 when he persistently barked at Louisville Metropolitan Police officers searching for a missing 3-year-old boy, who was found locked inside a car in a nearby garage. What happened: Officer Josh Thompson said he was initially "a little leery" of the unfamiliar dog, but when he jokingly told the collie "hey, let's go find this kid," the dog ran into a backyard and led officers to a parked car where the frightened toddler was locked in the front passenger seat. Thompson went into "dad mode," instructing the boy on how to unlock the door until he could pull it open -- at which point the child "jumped from the car, bear hugged my neck, and wouldn't let go." Why it matters: The boy was scared but unharmed and quickly reunited with his family, with Thompson crediting the dog as "a blessing from God that day." The collie turned out to be a well-known neighborhood fixture in the Okolona area, with local resident Sean Calloway introducing the dog to cameras and declaring him a hero -- prompting officers to celebrate by petting the dog and one cheering "Lassie found him." Democrat Rep. Ted Lieu uses fabricated Epstein document to accuse Trump of sex trafficking at Bondi hearing Democratic Rep. Ted Lieu during Wednesday's House Judiciary hearing with Attorney General Pam Bondi, citing a witness statement claiming a limo driver overheard Trump speaking with Epstein about alleged crimes and met a girl who said she was "raped by Donald Trump and Jeffrey Epstein." Lieu then accused Bondi of lying under oath for saying there is "no evidence of a crime" pertaining to the case. Bondi immediately fired back: "Don't you ever accuse me of a crime!" The problem: The document Lieu cited was entirely fabricated. The DOJ explicitly warned upon releasing the latest Epstein files that "this production may include fake or falsely submitted images, documents or videos" and that "some of the documents contain untrue and sensationalist claims against President Trump that were submitted to the FBI right before the 2020 election." The specific tip Lieu referenced also accused Hillary Clinton of orchestrating the Oklahoma City bombing in the same document. Why it matters: The incident is the latest example of Democrats seizing on unverified Epstein documents to attack Trump, despite the DOJ's clear warning that fabricated materials were included in the document dump. The DOJ noted that the claims "are unfounded and false, and if they have a shred of credibility, they certainly would have been weaponized against President Trump already." Federal judge releases four illegal immigrants convicted of murder and child sex crimes from ICE custody A federal judge in Louisiana, Obama appointee John deGravelles, from ICE custody on February 6, including individuals convicted of homicide, sexual exploitation of a minor, kidnapping, aggravated assault, and drug trafficking -- all of whom had existing deportation orders. | | ---|---|--- Who was released: The four men include Ibrahim Ali Mohammed, an Ethiopian citizen convicted of sexual exploitation of a minor with a 2024 deportation order; Luis Gaston-Sanchez, a Cuban national convicted of homicide and assault with a 2001 deportation order; Ricardo Blanco Chomat, also Cuban, convicted of homicide, kidnapping, and cocaine sales with a 2002 deportation order; and Francisco Rodriguez-Romero, convicted of homicide and weapons offenses with a 1995 deportation order. What the government said: DHS Assistant Secretary Tricia McLaughlin called the releases "inexcusably reckless," saying "the ramifications will only be the continued rape, murder, assault, and robbery of more American victims." She vowed that "if an immigration judge finds an illegal alien has no right to be in this country, we are going to remove them. Period." The Trump administration expanded ICE detention space at Louisiana State Penitentiary in September 2025 to house criminal illegal immigrants arrested by ICE. * You're currently a free subscriber to . When most Mississippians think about taxes, they picture April 15 or the total at the cash register. But for the farmers and loggers who keep our state's economy moving, taxes show up in a quieter, more punishing way--tacked onto the very tools they need to do their jobs.
That's why MS SB2272 deserves broad support. It's a modest, targeted step that would make a real difference for the people who put food on our tables and support our rural communities.
In plain terms, SB2272 exempts certain agricultural and logging items from Mississippi's 1.5% state sales tax when purchased by commercial farmers and loggers. This isn't a giveaway or a special-interest loophole. It's a recognition that a farmer's fencing and lime are not luxuries; they are essential business inputs, as fundamental to production as nails are to a carpenter.
The bill specifically includes items like livestock fencing materials and agricultural lime--things every working farmer understands as unavoidable, recurring costs. A cattle producer replacing worn-out fencing on several hundred acres can easily spend tens of thousands of dollars. Even a seemingly small 1.5% tax quickly adds up to money that could have gone toward feed, fuel, or payroll. A row-crop farmer applying lime to correct soil acidity faces the same squeeze: pay the tax, or cut corners and see yields suffer.
By lifting this tax burden, SB2272 lets commercial producers keep more of their own money--money they earned, money they will reinvest in their businesses and communities. That is economic freedom in practice, not theory.
Importantly, the bill does this while still respecting accountability. The exemption is not a blank check. It's tied to a permit process to ensure that only bona fide commercial farmers and loggers qualify. That means the tax relief is focused where it belongs: on those whose livelihood depends on agriculture and forestry, not on hobby farms or casual purchases.
From a liberty perspective, SB2272 is a small but meaningful step toward limited government. Every tax is, at its core, the state claiming a slice of private property. Policymakers should be especially cautious about taxing the basic means of production that allow people to earn an honest living. If we say we value work, entrepreneurship, and self-reliance, our tax code should reflect that.
This bill also respects the free market. It doesn't create a new subsidy or program; it simply removes a state-imposed cost that distorts business decisions. Farmers and loggers will still sink or swim based on their skill, their effort, and the market--not on whether they can shoulder yet another tax on their tools.
Citizens who care about a strong rural economy, about keeping family farms viable, and about restraining the reach of government should get behind SB2272. Contact your state senator and representative. Tell them you support tax relief for the people who work Mississippi's land and forests, and that you want a tax code that encourages production instead of penalizing it.
MS SB2272 won't fix every problem facing agriculture. But it's a clear step in the right direction: less government taking, more freedom to produce.

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

I'm Hope, Bushra Amiwala's campaign manager.
Early voting is officially underway in parts of IL-9.
The moment we have been building toward since June of last year has finally arrived.
Over countless events and 280 meet-and-greets. Tens of thousands of doors knocked. Hundreds of thousands of phone calls made and texts sent.
All the blood, sweat, and tears brought us to this moment--when voters can finally cast their ballot for Bushra and the movement we have built together.
None of this would have been possible without the support of our hardworking campaign staff, volunteers, and the thousands of Democrats nationwide who believed in Bushra and chipped in their hard earned money.
You built this.
But while early voting has started, we still have 33 days until the polls close -- and tens of thousands of voters left to reach.

name: Reid Rasner, CEO
subject: When the headlines get loud
body:
| Hi Peter,
---
If your phone notifications have felt louder than usual lately, you're not imagining it. Calls for the U.S. to annex Greenland.1 A military standoff with NATO allies.2 The threat of a new trade war with Europe.3 A criminal investigation into the Federal Reserve chair.4 It's the kind of headlines you'd expect from an action movie screenwriter hopped up on too much coffee. And investors have noticed. Stocks plunged. Yields surged. Gold skyrocketed.5 It's a lot to take in. But before getting into any details, I want to start with the most important point. _**Nothing meaningful about your long-term financial life probably changed this week.**_ Your goals are likely the same. Your timeline is likely the same. The reasons you invest are likely the same. What did change is how noisy the world feels. Here's the thing... Human brains are excellent at spotting danger. They're not great at separating "many surprising headlines at once" from "something that permanently alters the future." When uncertainty clusters, our nervous system treats it like a fire alarm. That reaction is normal. It's ancient. It kept our ancestors alive. It's also not a great portfolio manager. Markets react to stories in the short term. Fear. Relief. Speculation. Narratives that spread faster than facts. Over longer periods, markets care about slower, less dramatic things. Company profits. Interest rates. Inflation. Productivity. How much people spend and save. Those forces move gradually. Headlines move by the minute. This is why sharp market swings feel significant in the moment but often look small in hindsight. Big moves make for dramatic charts and urgent commentary. Over a multi-year plan, they usually become a footnote. It's like flying through turbulence. When a plane hits rough air, everything feels wrong. The cabin shakes. Drinks spill. Your body tenses up. It can feel dangerous even when the aircraft itself is operating exactly as designed. Turbulence is uncomfortable. It's loud. It gets your attention. It is not the same thing as the plane being in trouble. Volatility works the same way in markets. It isn't a sign that something is broken. It's the price investors pay for long-term growth. If markets were calm all the time, they'd also offer much lower returns. You can't separate the reward from the uncertainty any more than you can separate a smooth flight from the possibility of rough air. The real risk during weeks like this isn't what the market does next. It's what people do next. When fear is high, people get tempted to do very human things. Sell to stop the discomfort. Sit on the sidelines waiting for clarity. Chase whatever just went up. Rewrite long-term plans based on short-term emotion. Those decisions feel protective in the moment. Historically, however, they're typically how long-term returns get damaged. Your financial plan was built with weeks like this in mind. Not because volatility is pleasant. Because it's inevitable. Every decade has its version of "this feels unprecedented." The early 2000s had terror attacks. The late 2000s had a financial crisis. The 2020s opened with a pandemic and an inflation shock. Each period felt unstable while living through it. Markets kept compounding anyway, because progress is uneven but persistent. The things that most influence your financial future are still firmly in your control. How much you save. How diversified you are. How much risk you take relative to your goals. How disciplined you remain when emotions run hot. How long you stay invested. Those quiet decisions matter far more than any single week of headlines. **If you ever feel uneasy during periods like this, that's human. You don't need to suppress it. You just don't need to let it drive.** Markets will always have moments of turbulence. That's part of the journey. The goal isn't to eliminate every bump in the air. It's to stay in your seat, trust the design of the plane, and keep moving toward where you actually want to go. That's how short-term noise becomes long-term progress.
---
Warmly, **Reid Rasner - CEO**

clean_body: New Hampshire’s Senate race is tied. And I’m rattled. Peter, it’s James Carville. I’ve worked on more campaigns than I can count, and let me tell you: I don’t rattle easily. But this race in New Hampshire? It’s TIED. In a dead heat. And that should scare the hell out of every Democrat in the country. Here’s the deal: Jeanne Shaheen is retiring. That means this seat is wide open. And now John Sununu — yes, one of those Sununus, the long-time New Hampshire political dynasty — is running to flip it red. He’s got the name, he’s got the money, and he’s got the full weight of the Republican donor class behind him — from Wall Street to the far-right Super PACs. They see New Hampshire as their ticket to locking down the Senate for another decade. And right now? This race is neck-and-neck. It could go either way. Chris Pappas is our guy. He’s won the toughest district in New Hampshire four times. He knows how to reach voters across the aisle and build a coalition that wins. But he cannot — CANNOT — do this alone. So here’s what I need from you: If you have stored your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation to Chris Pappas and Heartland Patriots will process instantly: The GOP knows if they take New Hampshire, Democrats don’t have a shot at retaking the Senate. Peter,
The seeds of Trump's destruction may already have been sown. And the perpetrator is none other than Donald Trump himself.
Trump's decision to disregard every guardrail and flout every political custom and norm has, admittedly, gotten him pretty far. But that success has not extended to the Republican Party at large.
And now the GOP, and Trump along with it, is on the precipice of disaster: attempting to rig the 2026 Midterms by redrawing congressional districts in red states triggered Democratic blowback so fierce and so swift, it now threatens to result in a net loss to Republicans.
Here's what happened: after Trump commanded Texas to ram through a partisan proposal that eliminated 5 Dem seats in a matter of days, the sentiment of most of the country and among once gun-shy Democrats flipped.
Democrats were shaken out of the dazed stupor caused by losing the 2024 election. California and Virginia responded in kind.
And now Colorado Draws The Line is on the verge of bringing the full might of blue state Colorado into the fight, with the potential to put Democrats over the top by flipping three or even four GOP seats to safe blue territory.
If we succeed in getting our ballot proposition in front of CO voters, Trump will have awoken "a sleeping giant" that could very well lead to his defeat.
