subject: Six candidates sound-off at PA-03 Forum
body:
The leading candidates for the 3rd Congressional District seat presently held by retiring Rep. Dwight Evans met in a public, debate-style forum. | | | |
---
| | | **PA-03 Congressional Forum airs viewpoints of six hopeful candidates**
---
|
---
| Six of the candidates vying to take the place of retiring U.S. Rep. Dwight Evans (D-Pa.-3) squared off in a forum Monday evening.
Many of them–except the lone Republican, Alex Schnell–held similar views on various issues, so the race may depend on other factors such as personality, campaign funding, and who the voters believe is best able to step into Evans’ shoes.
The candidates discussed a wide range of issues, including healthcare, antisemitism, elections, and President Trump.
PoliticsPA’s Steve Ulrich, Gina Ceisler Shapiro, with Center City Residents’ Association, and Dick Polman with PhillyDaily, questioned the candidates. Polman asked about the hot-button topic of Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and the possibility of a Congressional statement shutting down the Department of Homeland Security. He noted that Rep. Chris Rabb (D-Philadelphia), who was absent from the forum, has previously called for ICE to be abolished.
State Sen. Sharif Street (D-Philadelphia) agreed that ICE should be abolished.
“It’s an organization that has recruited people from neo-Nazis,” said Street. “Donald Trump has given a badge that they don’t even use to the head of the Proud Boys. The culture of ICE has been corrupted...We should not have an agency that has been corrupted with neo-Nazis. We should not have an agency where a nurse at the V.A. can be held down by 10 people and shot five times and after he lay not moving, shot five more times.”
Dr. Ala Stanford said, as a pediatric surgeon, she’s “seen what bullets can do to the human body” and agreed ICE should be abolished. She said she should not have to explain to her child “that their freedom of speech is not honored and that they should have to worry about their mother when I speak up.”
“I will not support the paramilitary force that 47 is bringing to our cities,” said Stanford.
Schnell agreed that there are problems with how ICE is operating now but would reform and hold it accountable, rather than abolish it, because its function is necessary.
Pablo McConnie-Saad agreed ICE should be abolished and noted he is the only Latino running. ICE was not a “legacy agency” but was created by the Patriot Act after 9/11 “as part of the weaponization of the federal government on American citizens, along with the NSA (National Security Agency) and the mass movement to spy on U.S. citizens.”
“Both of my parents are Puerto Rican,” McConnie-Saad said. “They live in Puerto Rico and they are afraid of coming to Philadelphia to witness the birth of their first grandchild because they have witnessed ICE execute U.S. citizens in broad daylight.”
Dr. DavidOxman said, “If you have to wear a mask to hide your identity at work you need to ask yourself some questions about your job description.”
He said he cannot get the sound of the shots fired in the video of an ICE agent shooting Renee Good in Minneapolis out of his mind. But the demeanor of the agent just before was “just as shocking.”
“The sound of contempt in his voice, the arrogance of there being no authority greater than his own, that genie is not going back in the bottle,” said Oxman.
He called for Democrats to act.
“If this is not an issue worth standing up for, I really don’t know what is,” Oxman said.
State Rep. Morgan Cephas (D-Philadelphia) also said ICE should be and called for people to “lean on” the city and state governments not to cooperate with it. And she called for ICE detention centers to be shut down.
Ulrich asked how the candidates would tackle affordable housing.
McConnie-Saad bringing down energy costs through tax provisions for renewable energy would help. He called private equity firms buying housing “nefarious” and raising prices. And more houses for low-income families need to be built.
Philadelphia lacks 70,000 affordable housing units and 7,500 federally subsidized units are going to expire, said Cephas, calling for more to be built.
“We want to be sure Philadelphians can afford Philadelphia,” she said, and agreed that private equity firms purchasing housing and apartments is a problem. “We have to make sure we don’t have New Yorkers just buying up our city and forcing people out of their homes.”
Children are the largest growing population of the homeless, said Oxman.
“The federal government needs to step in and spend more money on affordable housing,” he said. “We need a Marshall Plan on housing.”
Street said he’s secured more affordable housing, working with Habitat for Humanity, the Philadelphia Housing Authority and developers, but more needs to be done. He called for Massachusetts’ U.S. Senator Elizabeth Warren’s plan to ban private equity from owning residential homes to come to Pennsylvania. If elected to the House, he said he would sponsor a bill to mirror hers.
Stanford said she lived in public housing growing up and knows how important it is to have a home. Home ownership is linked to wealth, education and health, she said.
“For me, welfare was a bridge, not a crutch, and I would support that for others,” she said.
More than 200 people came to the Church of the Holy Trinity on Rittenhouse Square to see the forum, which was broadcasted on Pennsylvania Cable Network (PCN) and through the Fideri News Network.
Others running for the 3rd District include: Democrats Karl Morris, Cole Carter, Isaiah Martin, Robin Toldens, and Republican Sheila Armstrong.
The primary is slated for May 19.

Dwight Evans met in a public, debate-style forum. | | | | | | | PA-03 Congressional Forum airs viewpoints of six hopeful candidates | | Six of the candidates vying to take the place of retiring U.S. Rep. Dwight Evans (D-Pa.-3) squared off in a forum Monday evening. Many of them–except the lone Republican, Alex Schnell–held similar views on various issues, so the race may depend on other factors such as personality, campaign funding, and who the voters believe is best able to step into Evans’ shoes. The candidates discussed a wide range of issues, including healthcare, antisemitism, elections, and President Trump. PoliticsPA’s Steve Ulrich, Gina Ceisler Shapiro, with Center City Residents’ Association, and Dick Polman with PhillyDaily, questioned the candidates. Polman asked about the hot-button topic of Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and the possibility of a Congressional statement shutting down the Department of Homeland Security. He noted that Rep. Chris Rabb (D-Philadelphia), who was absent from the forum, has previously called for ICE to be abolished. State Sen. Sharif Street (D-Philadelphia) agreed that ICE should be abolished. “It’s an organization that has recruited people from neo-Nazis,” said Street. “Donald Trump has given a badge that they don’t even use to the head of the Proud Boys. The culture of ICE has been corrupted...We should not have an agency that has been corrupted with neo-Nazis. We should not have an agency where a nurse at the V.A. can be held down by 10 people and shot five times and after he lay not moving, shot five more times.” Dr. Ala Stanford said, as a pediatric surgeon, she’s “seen what bullets can do to the human body” and agreed ICE should be abolished. She said she should not have to explain to her child “that their freedom of speech is not honored and that they should have to worry about their mother when I speak up.” “I will not support the paramilitary force that 47 is bringing to our cities,” said Stanford. Schnell agreed that there are problems with how ICE is operating now but would reform and hold it accountable, rather than abolish it, because its function is necessary. Pablo McConnie-Saad agreed ICE should be abolished and noted he is the only Latino running. ICE was not a “legacy agency” but was created by the Patriot Act after 9/11 “as part of the weaponization of the federal government on American citizens, along with the NSA (National Security Agency) and the mass movement to spy on U.S. citizens.” “Both of my parents are Puerto Rican,” McConnie-Saad said. “They live in Puerto Rico and they are afraid of coming to Philadelphia to witness the birth of their first grandchild because they have witnessed ICE execute U.S. citizens in broad daylight.” Dr. DavidOxman said, “If you have to wear a mask to hide your identity at work you need to ask yourself some questions about your job description.” He said he cannot get the sound of the shots fired in the video of an ICE agent shooting Renee Good in Minneapolis out of his mind. But the demeanor of the agent just before was “just as shocking.” “The sound of contempt in his voice, the arrogance of there being no authority greater than his own, that genie is not going back in the bottle,” said Oxman. He called for Democrats to act. “If this is not an issue worth standing up for, I really don’t know what is,” Oxman said. State Rep. Morgan Cephas (D-Philadelphia) also said ICE should be and called for people to “lean on” the city and state governments not to cooperate with it. And she called for ICE detention centers to be shut down. Ulrich asked how the candidates would tackle affordable housing. McConnie-Saad bringing down energy costs through tax provisions for renewable energy would help. He called private equity firms buying housing “nefarious” and raising prices. And more houses for low-income families need to be built. Philadelphia lacks 70,000 affordable housing units and 7,500 federally subsidized units are going to expire, said Cephas, calling for more to be built. “We want to be sure Philadelphians can afford Philadelphia,” she said, and agreed that private equity firms purchasing housing and apartments is a problem. “We have to make sure we don’t have New Yorkers just buying up our city and forcing people out of their homes.” Children are the largest growing population of the homeless, said Oxman. “The federal government needs to step in and spend more money on affordable housing,” he said. “We need a Marshall Plan on housing.” Street said he’s secured more affordable housing, working with Habitat for Humanity, the Philadelphia Housing Authority and developers, but more needs to be done. He called for Massachusetts’ U.S. Senator Elizabeth Warren’s plan to ban private equity from owning residential homes to come to Pennsylvania. If elected to the House, he said he would sponsor a bill to mirror hers. Stanford said she lived in public housing growing up and knows how important it is to have a home. Home ownership is linked to wealth, education and health, she said. “For me, welfare was a bridge, not a crutch, and I would support that for others,” she said. More than 200 people came to the Church of the Holy Trinity on Rittenhouse Square to see the forum, which was broadcasted on Pennsylvania Cable Network (PCN) and through the Fideri News Network. Others running for the 3rd District include: Democrats Karl Morris, Cole Carter, Isaiah Martin, Robin Toldens, and Republican Sheila Armstrong. body:
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
You are invited to join our one-click issue response poll.
Please do not complete this survey if your email address is not dpwillis67@gmail.com .
Alleged non-citizen voting has been a talking point since the 2024 elections.
However, the nonpartisan Center for Election Innovation & Research spent much of 2025 tracking state governments and their efforts across the country, and has confirmed that non-citizen voting is extremely rare and non-coordinated.
In fact, Louisiana's Republican Secretary of State Nancy Landry recently announced that a grand total of 79 possible non-citizens had voted in the state over the last 40 years. The nonpartisan Brennan Center for Justice estimates that more than 74 million votes were cast in Louisiana over that time period, making this approximately 1 out of every 1 million votes cast.
Secretary of State Landry also acknowledged that she couldn’t even be sure that those 79 were actual cases of ineligible votes being cast — some may have been incorrectly identified as a result of data errors or outdated information.
We want to hear from voters in your area about this topic. Will you take our one-question poll right away?

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Today, Justice Democrats is proud to announce our twelfth endorsement of
the 2026 election cycle: Kat Abughazaleh in Illinois’ 9th congressional
district!

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260212-ka.lRme6-&refcode=em20260212-37459&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=37459%2E1203867%2EGHom2N ]Justice Democrats 2026 Endorsed Kat Abughazaleh for U.S. Congress IL-09

Kat is a renter, former uninsured worker, and union representative who has
spent her career fighting right-wing extremism as a journalist with Media
Matters for America and a contributor to outlets including Mother Jones
and Zeteo News.

She’s running to bring a new generation of leadership to Congress and to
defend democracy, fight for economic justice, and advance a humane foreign
policy.

And this primary already has an AIPAC-backed candidate looking to buy this
election with their GOP megadonor money.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260212-ka.lRme6-&refcode=em20260212-37459&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=37459%2E1203867%2EGHom2N ]Rush a donation of $5 or more to Justice Democrats and
Kat’s people-powered campaign now to help her defeat AIPAC next month →

Kat has spent her career doing what so many voters are desperate to see
the Democratic Party do: fight back against Republican extremism and fight
for everyday people.

In this moment, she is the type of progressive leadership we need in
Congress — leadership that isn't too afraid to take on AIPAC or corporate
PACs to defeat right-wing fascism or corporate corruption in the
Democratic Party.

Kat has spent years studying the far right and knows how to meet the
moment we are in. She has been standing up to fascism by protesting in the
streets, putting her body on the line time and time again. Kat was even
charged by the federal government in a clear act of political retribution
just a week after an ICE agent threw her to the ground and injured her at
a protest last September.

She has called for abolishing and prosecuting ICE, and has never wavered
on calling Israel’s actions in Gaza a genocide.

As a proud Palestinian-American, Kat has always passionately supported
Palestinian self-determination free from occupation and oppression. In
Congress, she will strongly push for the United States to stop enabling
Israel’s genocide in Gaza and illegal occupation of the West Bank, and
instead establish bilateral relations with a sovereign and independent
State of Palestine.

Kat is also determined to:

* Overturn Citizens United to end the funnel of dark money through Super
PACs.
* Propose a 2% tax on the wealthy to fund government programs and
nonprofits providing essential services.
* Raise the federal minimum wage to $25 an hour.
* Pass universal healthcare and universal childcare.

At a time when so many career politicians in the party have to be
convinced to condemn genocide, we are proud to support a first-time
candidate who has the moral clarity to oppose bottomless budgets for
Israel's ethnic cleansing, abolish ICE, and fight for every person to
afford the life they deserve.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260212-ka.lRme6-&refcode=em20260212-37459&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1004&akid=37459%2E1203867%2EGHom2N ]That’s why she’s counting on our movement to help her rise to the top
and win this primary, which is just one month away. Join JD in supporting
Kat today: split a grassroots contribution to fuel our work and win next
month!

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260212-ka.lRme6-&refcode=em20260212-37459&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1023&akid=37459%2E1203867%2EGHom2N ]Contribute $5

In solidarity,

Alexandra Rojas
Executive Director

---
| | Friends,
Real experience and leadership are not learned from a textbook or proven through political rhetoric. They are proven in real moments. They are tested when it is inconvenient. And they are revealed when the phone rings.
This past Super Bowl Sunday is a real example of what that responsibility looks like.
Under the Michigan Constitution and state law, the Attorney General is the chief law enforcement officer for the State of Michigan. At the county level, that responsibility falls to the elected Prosecuting Attorney. As Eaton County Prosecutor, there is no 9-5\. I am on call 24 hours a day, seven days a week.
So when the phone rings, I answer. High-stakes situations demand experience, judgment, and leadership.
My Super Bowl Sunday began with calls from law enforcement partners regarding a deceased individual discovered at a residence in the City of Lansing. Because a portion of Lansing falls within Eaton County, the matter required my direct involvement as prosecuting attorney.
In an active homicide investigation, the prosecutor does not conduct the investigation. The prosecutor ensures it is done lawfully and correctly. That means providing real-time legal guidance on crime scene protocols, constitutional limits, and evidentiary standards for search warrants. Throughout the day and into the evening, I remained in constant communication with investigators and responded to the scene to assist with reviewing and authorizing search warrants. There is no room for error.
What happens in the first hours, and sometimes days, can determine whether justice is ultimately served if a death is later ruled criminal by the medical examiner. Those decisions also affect victims and their families, public safety, and the integrity of our justice system.
I have been honored to receive endorsements from law enforcement across Michigan, and especially humbled by the support of retired Chief of Police and former [Eaton Rapids Mayor Paul Malewski, who recently wrote in support of my candidacy.](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001R9__FzGtM9YxTtObx7LiKP4JgrzNJc7lkqrlF4HxK0UGMZYxFupN5Dih5RBlD7TwgFgcTvvci9ka-zDWowui5TQF1EawzCyf6r9gX9IOvfLFluL6KWAtOWFgIJtPRsn2-rm74rWf22VwNywcEmN-NXxqrYcgccf8s4H2UQRvyWaZ2SLKIkd763KWmJDkn3Vnf6b3VuDOUF8GEt4fMqjfxldRexnv83thClq0WqwxR0tVeOWBE7xoJat3AlePnRPURUULHuXF-vk=&c=IK3ipy0zKXiSY5Xiwyox1AcFYJWWcXMkSREgpuXfsbr_EabTkEuUww==&ch=mWw27FXFoojMgby246Eg-__hmI4-Wqjfj9P9dCb5mGg6n-14EzS8eA==)
In moments like that Sunday, there is no politics. There is only responsibility. I will bring that same experience, judgment, and commitment to restoring priorities and integrity to the Michigan Attorney General's Office.
Sincerely,
Doug Lloyd Eaton County Prosecuting Attorney Candidate for Michigan Attorney General

clean_body: Experience Answers When Leadership is Required | | | | | == | | | | | == | | | == | | Friends, Real experience and leadership are not learned from a textbook or proven through political rhetoric. They are proven in real moments. They are tested when it is inconvenient. And they are revealed when the phone rings. This past Super Bowl Sunday is a real example of what that responsibility looks like. Under the Michigan Constitution and state law, the Attorney General is the chief law enforcement officer for the State of Michigan. At the county level, that responsibility falls to the elected Prosecuting Attorney. As Eaton County Prosecutor, there is no 9-5\. I am on call 24 hours a day, seven days a week. So when the phone rings, I answer. High-stakes situations demand experience, judgment, and leadership. My Super Bowl Sunday began with calls from law enforcement partners regarding a deceased individual discovered at a residence in the City of Lansing. Because a portion of Lansing falls within Eaton County, the matter required my direct involvement as prosecuting attorney. In an active homicide investigation, the prosecutor does not conduct the investigation. The prosecutor ensures it is done lawfully and correctly. That means providing real-time legal guidance on crime scene protocols, constitutional limits, and evidentiary standards for search warrants. Throughout the day and into the evening, I remained in constant communication with investigators and responded to the scene to assist with reviewing and authorizing search warrants. There is no room for error. What happens in the first hours, and sometimes days, can determine whether justice is ultimately served if a death is later ruled criminal by the medical examiner. Those decisions also affect victims and their families, public safety, and the integrity of our justice system. I have been honored to receive endorsements from law enforcement across Michigan, and especially humbled by the support of retired Chief of Police and former == In moments like that Sunday, there is no politics. There is only responsibility. I will bring that same experience, judgment, and commitment to restoring priorities and integrity to the Michigan Attorney General's Office. This is why our mission is so important.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260212-1&t=1&akid=3144%2E587540%2ENOyKnm)
Peter, it is infuriating to watch the Trump administration wreak havoc on our government and enact their dangerous, destructive agenda.
We need to be taking pages out of Mitch McConnell’s playbook that he used for years to stop Obama, to stop Biden, and prevent Democrats from passing our agenda. Everything has to be on the table to stop and slow Trump.
On top of that, we need to be organizing against vulnerable Republicans and turning the screws on them. We have to make their lives as painful as possible and line up the incentives for them to oppose Trump.
And finally we have to look ahead to upcoming elections and get behind people that are filled with rage over Trump’s actions and have a burning fire within them to stop Trump. People who will fight aggressively for a vision of this country that allows us to have more affordable housing, better healthcare, and provides some real economic opportunity and security.
That’s where we come in.
**[Can you pitch in $5 now to power our mission to elect the next generation of leaders?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260212_1_infuriating.4DXARc&refcode=em20260212-3144&amount=5&t=2&akid=3144%2E587540%2ENOyKnm)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260212_1_infuriating.4DXARc&amount=5&refcode=em20260212-3144&t=21&akid=3144%2E587540%2ENOyKnm)**
This is no joke. _Every single day counts in the fight ahead._
**Here’s the truth:** The GOP is already gearing up for the next fight. If we don’t keep our fundraising on track, the billionaires and corporate elite will keep pouring money into the Republican right-wing agenda while Democrats and progressives are left scrambling.
**But we’re not going to let that happen.** We may not have the special interests on our side, but I know that the grassroots can be even more powerful.
**We need leaders who fight for working families, voting rights, and climate justice. Leaders who will not back down when things get tough.**
That’s exactly why Leaders We Deserve exists. Now, we need your help to make sure we can keep electing the young, progressive leaders we deserve.
**[Can you chip in $5 now to help power our game-changing work?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260212_1_infuriating.4DXARc&refcode=em20260212-3144&amount=5&t=22&akid=3144%2E587540%2ENOyKnm)**

After 25 years in uniform and another 5 in the United States Senate, I never imagined I’d have to do something like that. Hegseth has left me no choice.

When he censured me and threatened my rank and retirement, he came after what I earned over 25 years – and chilled the free speech rights of every retired member of the military alongside me.

If Hegseth isn’t stopped, our longest-serving military veterans will have to live with the constant threat that they could be deprived of their rank and pension years – even decades – after they leave the military if they say something he doesn’t like.

I’m not going to sit by and let that happen. So, I sued Hegseth. And now, we wait and see what the court decides.

That’s how we’ve made it this far, and it’s how we’ll get to the other side of this chapter in our nation’s history. Together.

disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY DEFEND OUR COURTS, NOT AUTHORIZED BY ANY CANDIDATE
body:
He’s called an unprecedented and shadowy meeting with state election officials
| | | | | [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001wkw7sTNeUweJttel4pzE68FsUC0f55qTiN1AEt5Rjx6tOIjBKFSjVyJkh51oDzb0azNqTrRB-sXrEA0geaIAGyBnDiSs67KG-6zHCJs3Ejh6jOnRx9FYPPx1cMdeUtQAG9v1oyARGN3bFx1EnXbTIBp4nONtWWFEZDHT914CGVxAE9ZBEgrZq62T1OhqgMQ5K2jRBuC00NcZzOIgqnT6lCHytnDSQnz-ucE8ELJKszaDm4CbEPKZIQ==&c=QvAvPY2g_D-Ao0UDEsJcoXMYrU1qJUBotfcMRP3-qtoDbaIgU3qW5w==&ch=7HFS3cv4fl2DlPuYWlHY4PbWl6gIMv7o3_0TGi46WEzMQ7LYbADXig==)
---
| Peter,
Since we launched in spring 2025, we've been sounding the alarm about Trump's plan to rig our elections.
The Constitution is clear. States run elections. That is why MAGA is trying to seize control of state Supreme Courts in key swing states, where these courts have the final say on how elections are administered.
That is why we built Defend Our Courts. And last year in Pennsylvania, we proved it works by helping Democrats hold the Supreme Court and stopping a Trump takeover in the most important swing state in the country.
Now, Trump is turning up the election rigging dial to 11.
First, he sent the FBI into Fulton County, Georgia's election offices and seized 2020 ballots--desperately trying to resurrect his rigged-election conspiracy.
Then he demanded Republicans nationalize elections, handing control of voting to the federal government.
Next, his top advisor and loyal attack dog, Steve Bannon, openly called for Trump to deploy ICE to surround polling places.
And now he's called an unprecedented and shadowy meeting with state election officials to intimidate them:
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001wkw7sTNeUweJttel4pzE68FsUC0f55qTiN1AEt5Rjx6tOIjBKFSjVyJkh51oDzb0azNqTrRB-sXrEA0geaIAGyBnDiSs67KG-6zHCJs3Ejh6jOnRx9FYPPx1cMdeUtQAG9v1oyARGN3bFx1EnXbTIBp4nONtWWFEZDHT914CGVxAE9ZBEgrZq62T1OhqgMQ5K2jRBuC00NcZzOIgqnT6lCHytnDSQnz-AnbQWp4wx5bPeHpW33obaQ==&c=QvAvPY2g_D-Ao0UDEsJcoXMYrU1qJUBotfcMRP3-qtoDbaIgU3qW5w==&ch=7HFS3cv4fl2DlPuYWlHY4PbWl6gIMv7o3_0TGi46WEzMQ7LYbADXig==)
---
The fight for democracy is at a breaking point. What we do in the next 10 months could decide whether it survives at all.
That is why Defend Our Courts is expanding nationwide this year. With state Supreme Court races in the swing states of Wisconsin, Michigan, and Georgia, the mission has never been more urgent.
We cannot allow Trump even a single opening to seize control of these courts. If he does, free and fair elections are finished.
With more than 100,000 grassroots donors across the country, we are one of the largest forces standing between MAGA and a hostile takeover of our courts. But this fight will be expensive. MAGA is expected to pour massive money into these races, possibly more than into key Senate and House contests.

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: I told Jeanine Pirro: Preserve your records
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
As a former CIA officer, I've seen democracies flicker out.
Friends,
In November, myself and five other Members of Congress made a video quoting current law, that the military has a responsibility to refuse illegal orders.
In response, President Trump tweeted more than a dozen times, calling for me to be investigated, arrested, and hanged.
Since then, the FBI and former Fox News host Jeanine Pirro, now U.S. Attorney for the District of Columbia, asked to interview me for the inquiry.
I wanted to share an important update on all of this, and ask for your help.
I wrote to Attorney General Pam Bondi and U.S. Attorney Pirro to inform them that I won’t be doing an interview — and that their offices should preserve their records should I decide to sue for their infringement on my Constitutional rights.
I am not going to legitimize what they’re doing. The video in question was public, and I’ve talked about it extensively in the open. Our Constitution is crystal clear about our freedom of speech — and that’s a value worth fighting for.
To be honest, very smart people have told me to keep my head down and be quiet — that doing so would make this inquiry go away. But that’s exactly what Trump and Pirro want. They are employing physical and legal intimidation to get me to shut up. And, much more importantly, to deter other people from criticizing them.
So I’m taking the opposite approach, and I am fighting back, because this is bigger than any one Senator or any one video. If they can do this to me, what can they do to a business leader or the head of a community foundation or a mom who goes viral on the internet for criticizing Donald Trump?
And what people like Jeanine Pirro need to understand is that while the President of the United States may have immunity according to the Supreme Court, those who do his bidding do not. And if they are going to salute and do what he wants as part of this weaponization, they are going to own those consequences.
We all own our choices. I own mine. And Pirro and Trump must own theirs.
This is where I need your help. As I've said before, fighting back against these abuses of power requires a political strategy and a legal strategy. We're opening up an entire new front on the legal strategy — one that goes on offense. But taken together, it requires resources, and that is why I am asking:
**[Can you please split a contribution between my campaign and Chris Pappas to help me continue fighting back against the attacks on me and on our Constitution from a president hell-bent on revenge against those who speak out?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260212_1.Q7WIB3&refcode=em20260212-1&t=1&akid=5078%2E582294%2E9lrWsy)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260212_1.Q7WIB3&amount=5&refcode=em20260212-1&t=20&akid=5078%2E582294%2E9lrWsy)**
I've asked people to fight back and push back. And if I am going to live the values that I preach, that means I have to take some additional risk myself.
That is what I am doing, and I appreciate your support as we go forward.
Elissa Slotkin
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260212_1.Q7WIB3&amount=5&refcode=em20260212-1&t=21&akid=5078%2E582294%2E9lrWsy)**

clean_body: | | | Peter, Right now, Congress is negotiating whether to send more of our tax dollars to the Department of Homeland Security and keep bankrolling ICE’s rogue campaign of fear, raids, and family separation. We need to organize now, because we’ve already seen what happens when politicians aren’t held accountable. Just last month, seven House Democrats joined Republicans to keep funding ICE’s reign of terror, handing the GOP the votes they needed to push the bill through the House. But after massive public pressure from across the country, Senate Democrats held the line and blocked the DHS funding bill. That’s why we’re coming together to map out how to turn our frustration into action and make sure every member of Congress knows there’s a political price for voting for cruelty. We’ve won real fights before by flooding phone lines, sending thousands of letters, and refusing to back down. It’s how working people have forced change in Washington. And it’s exactly what we need to do again, right now. The stakes go far beyond ICE, Peter. While Congress pours millions into raids and deportations, 22 million people are struggling with skyrocketing, unaffordable healthcare costs. Families are being forced to choose between paying for medicine, rent, or food — and this isn’t accidental. It’s a political choice. Cruelty is being prioritized over care, billionaires over working families, and surveillance over solutions. And while working people are stepping up to meet this moment courageously across the country, too often, Democratic Party leadership isn’t. That’s why the Working Families Party is building something different: a political party that puts working people first, every time. Not corporate donors, and not political convenience. Right now, the fight in front of us is clear, and urgent: we need to pressure everymember of Congress — Republicans and Democrats alike — to reject DHS funding and invest in our communities instead. body:
Anna Paulina Luna, a Veteran, wants to make it harder for men and women in uniform to vote. And for that, Congresswoman, you should expect to hear from us.
#
Peter, this is Congresswoman Anna Paulina Luna from Florida.
[](https://act.votevets.org/go/19502?source=em260212-1-90&t=1&akid=34939%2E3013755%2ERpBoVg)
She’s an Air Force Veteran, and we’re grateful she chose to serve.
The gratitude ends there.
Since entering Congress, she’s been one of the most extreme voices in the House. Most recently, that’s manifested in taking on Trump’s fight against fair elections. The GOP knows they’re headed for trouble this November, and they’re out to suppress the vote because that’s the only way they think they can win.
Last night, she voted for the SAVE America Act, and it passed the House. That bill is a direct attack on the voting rights of Servicemembers, Veterans, and their families. It would not allow them to use their Military IDs alone to vote. It would virtually eliminate all online and mail-in voter registration. And it could force disabled Veterans, and millions of Veterans in rural communities to drive for hours just to register to vote.
Anna Paulina Luna, a Veteran, wants to make it harder for men and women in uniform to vote. And for that, Congresswoman, you should expect to hear from us.
VoteVets is taking the fight to Republicans who back these voter suppression bills, and we’re doing everything we can to stop it from passing the House. But we can’t do it alone.

**NEW SCHOOL PERFORMANCE AND SUPPORT FRAMEWORK BILL ADVANCES** The Youngkin Administration was anxious to push through a new school performance framework by which we assess how schools are doing. The issue is that it was rushed. JLARC was asked to analyze the new framework and compare it to what other states are doing. JLARC is our best entity in the Virginia government to analyze key policies through a non-partisan lens. JLARC issued a report and offered several changes. HB 643 passed out of the Education Committee and will implement several of those changes.

name: Pete Barlow for Congress
subject: Running in the Sixth - until the people speak
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pete Barlow For Congress
body:
Confused about the map, the elections, the candidates? We have info you need.

| |
---
| | Dear Friend: In recent decades, members of Congress have lost sight of their primary duty to speak for real communities with real needs. Washington now revolves more around big money interests that want us divided and fighting while they take what they will from the public coffers. No one embodies that divisive agenda more than Ben Cline in Virginia’s Sixth District. So I left FEMA and launched my campaign in August, promising to reconnect neighbors, solve shared problems, and advocate robustly for Sixth District communities in Congress. While I have been listening and learning from my neighbors, the voters gave Democrats full control in Richmond, and Trump demanded that Republican-controlled states redraw their congressional maps to ensure that Republicans retain control of Congress. Virginia Democrats have responded with a proposed redistricting map released to the public last week. Unlike in Republican-controlled states, **Virginia requires voters to approve mid-decade redistricting plans.** There is also a court case challenging the process. Assuming the Virginia Supreme Court rules that the process for drawing the map was legal, Virginia voters will decide whether to approve the map drawn by the Democrats. Early voting will start on March 6, and the **referendum voting will conclude on April 21.** The **congressional****primary will move to August 4** , with early voting commencing on June 16. The **general election remains on November 3,** with early voting starting on September 18. **My team and I deeply believe in democracy, which means the proposed map is not in place until the people have had their say.** Therefore, I have made the following announcement about where we will focus the campaign. If the people affirm the new map, we still have time to reach voters in new areas. clean_body: Confused about the map, the elections, the candidates? We have info you need. | | | | Dear Friend: In recent decades, members of Congress have lost sight of their primary duty to speak for real communities with real needs. Washington now revolves more around big money interests that want us divided and fighting while they take what they will from the public coffers. No one embodies that divisive agenda more than Ben Cline in Virginia’s Sixth District. So I left FEMA and launched my campaign in August, promising to reconnect neighbors, solve shared problems, and advocate robustly for Sixth District communities in Congress. While I have been listening and learning from my neighbors, the voters gave Democrats full control in Richmond, and Trump demanded that Republican-controlled states redraw their congressional maps to ensure that Republicans retain control of Congress. Virginia Democrats have responded with a proposed redistricting map released to the public last week. Unlike in Republican-controlled states, Virginia requires voters to approve mid-decade redistricting plans. There is also a court case challenging the process. Assuming the Virginia Supreme Court rules that the process for drawing the map was legal, Virginia voters will decide whether to approve the map drawn by the Democrats. Early voting will start on March 6, and the referendum voting will conclude on April 21. The congressionalprimary will move to August 4 , with early voting commencing on June 16. The general election remains on November 3, with early voting starting on September 18. My team and I deeply believe in democracy, which means the proposed map is not in place until the people have had their say. Therefore, I have made the following announcement about where we will focus the campaign. If the people affirm the new map, we still have time to reach voters in new areas. Meanwhile, please help me continue bringing people together in the Shenandoah Valley, the Roanoke River Valley, the Alleghany Highlands, and the Blue Ridge Mountains to discuss what they really want from their member of Congress. **Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football 's 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. | | Peter,
There are just **FIVE days** until early voting begins – this Tuesday, Feb. 17 – and we have **unstoppable momentum**.
Here are just some of the major updates recently for our campaign:
* **TRUMP ENDORSEMENT**. President Trump endorsed Mark, saying he is a “tremendous America First Candidate” and has “my Complete and Total Endorsement.” [_Read more_](https://teixeiraforcongress.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=aaeca7d0d6f0c241ad9d38cc7&id=1af2509ddb&e=2814cf23ed).
* **NEW TV AD**. We launched our new TV ad focused on keeping Texas families safe. [_Watch here_](https://teixeiraforcongress.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=aaeca7d0d6f0c241ad9d38cc7&id=6f7cc44a67&e=2814cf23ed).
* **SINCLAIR ON BOARD**. One of Mark’s opponents in TX-21, Kyle Sinclair, suspended his campaign and endorsed Mark. [_Read more_](https://teixeiraforcongress.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=aaeca7d0d6f0c241ad9d38cc7&id=70210eaadd&e=2814cf23ed).
* **MAJOR ENDORSEMENTS**. We announced major endorsements from Turning Point Action, Club for Growth PAC, AFP Action, Speaker Johnson and Whip Emmer, Young Conservatives of Texas, and Moms for America Action. [_See all_](https://teixeiraforcongress.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=aaeca7d0d6f0c241ad9d38cc7&id=078b4b3aa3&e=2814cf23ed).

When we first entered this race in August, Mark pledge to campaign hard, meet with voters across the district, and earn every vote. That’s exactly what we’ve done – traveling to all counties in the district, and many of them multiple times.
We’re not letting up in the home stretch! Join us for a [**Get Out the Vote Rally tomorrow evening in San Antonio**](https://teixeiraforcongress.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=aaeca7d0d6f0c241ad9d38cc7&id=d34696c698&e=2814cf23ed) featuring Kyle Sinclair.
And be sure to [**sign up to volunteer**](https://teixeiraforcongress.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=aaeca7d0d6f0c241ad9d38cc7&id=bf50ae6de1&e=2814cf23ed) – block walk, make calls, or work polling places. Any amount of time will make a big difference. We’re in this together to keep Texas safe, prosperous and free. Thank you!
For Texas,
**TEAM MARK TEIXEIRA** Trump-Endorsed America First ConservativeTexas’ 21st Congressional District

body:

Hi Peter,

Years ago, I showed up to a protest in support of workers and unions
fighting for a fair wage, and I got arrested:

[ A ]A screenshot of the old news clip showing Abdul being arrested.

I didn’t go looking to cause trouble, and I certainly didn’t expect to end
up loaded into a police car that day.

I was there because people were fighting for dignity, and it mattered to
stand with them.

Afterward, when my lawyer asked whether I wanted to try to get my own
charge dismissed, my answer was simple: It’s everybody or nobody.

Solidarity means something, and I wasn’t interested in special treatment.

That moment has stayed with me years later, because it clarified something
I’ve always believed: Progress only happens when we stand together,
especially when it’s uncomfortable or costly.

That’s why I support a higher minimum wage. It’s why I stand with unions.
And why I won’t stop fighting until our government prioritizes working
people instead of corporate profits.

[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260212-1-ak.8IoQMx&amount=10&refcode=em20260212-1681&t=1004&akid=1690%2E251025%2E0u8LEQ ]If you’re with me, please pitch in $10 today. I’m the
only candidate in this race who’s never taken money from corporate PACs or
AIPAC, and staying unbought and true to our values means I’m depending on
grassroots support to fuel this movement.

Thank you. Your support makes it possible for me to keep showing up.

Your friend in the fight,

Abdul

# Tariff cash explosion rocks deficit drama

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/863bcd90-2351-4c85-95d9-458b8fddd62d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Revenue Surge Details:** January's $30 billion in customs duties pushed year-to-date collections to $124 billion, marking a dramatic 304% increase over the prior year's equivalent period.
* **Deficit Impact Noted:** The tariff windfall contributed to a narrower federal budget deficit, with January's shortfall down 26% from last year and the year-to-date deficit reduced by 17% (or 21% adjusted).
* **Tariff Origins Explained:** President Trump implemented across-the-board and reciprocal tariffs starting in April 2025, though negotiations have softened some rates while maintaining strong trade stances.
* **Court Ruling Stakes:** A potential negative Supreme Court decision on the "Fentanyl Liberation Day Tariffs" legality could require reimbursing billions in collected duties, threatening fiscal stability amid ongoing trade talks.

# Trump slashes feds to the lowest since 1966
Federal civilian employment plummeted to 2.686 million in January 2026 -- **[the lowest level since May 1966](https://substack.com/redirect/d201c608-f76a-4d2a-ac94-827464f29640?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** -- as President Trump's administration and the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) drove massive workforce reductions through attrition, buyouts, and program cuts during his first year back in office.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d201c608-f76a-4d2a-ac94-827464f29640?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Massive exodus recorded** : Over 322,000 federal employees exited in the first year of Trump's second term, marking the largest workforce reduction in two decades via resignations, retirements, and limited layoffs.
* **Sharp agency declines hit** : Health and Human Services lost 20,000 positions dropping to 62,000 employees while USAID shrank 92% from 4,800 to just 378 staff after being folded into the State Department.
* **Education department trimmed** : The Department of Education cut more than 1,700 jobs, reducing its workforce to roughly 2,500 employees in early 2025 amid broader bureaucratic consolidation efforts.
* **DOGE targets wasteful spending** : The initiative terminated dozens of high-value contracts worth billions in ceiling value, yielding hundreds of millions in savings by eliminating duplicative administrative and support services.

# AA Flight attendants revolt, CEO faces ouster
American Airlines flight attendants plan to picket headquarters in Fort Worth, Texas, on Thursday **[after their union issued a historic vote of no confidence](https://substack.com/redirect/c61f985a-68be-4f2a-ac28-2a7f9403f179?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in CEO Robert Isom, escalating pressure over lagging profits, poor punctuality, and operational struggles that trail rivals Delta and United.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c61f985a-68be-4f2a-ac28-2a7f9403f179?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Union Issues No Confidence** : The Association of Professional Flight Attendants unanimously voted no confidence in CEO Robert Isom, a first in its history, citing a "relentless downward spiral" and demands for leadership change.
* **Protest Targets Accountability** : Flight attendants will demonstrate outside Skyview 8 headquarters to demand improved operational support, real accountability, and decisive action amid frustration with recovery from winter storms.
* **Company Lags Competitors** : American posted just $111 million net income in 2025 versus Delta's $5 billion and United's $3.3 billion, resulting in smaller profit-sharing pools despite recent high-wage contracts.
* **CEO Pushes Optimism** : Robert Isom released messages highlighting expected 2026 profit jumps up to $2.70 EPS, schedule fixes, cabin upgrades, and free Wi-Fi to reassure employees ahead of the picket.

# Alphabet's century long bond sparks AI debt alarm
Alphabet issued a rare 100-year Pounds-Sterlingterling bond as part of a massive borrowing spree to fund soaring AI infrastructure costs, drawing warnings from strategists about late-cycle credit market exuberance and **[risks in the hyperscaler debt surge.](https://substack.com/redirect/1377f2de-939c-4ea3-8f25-981d7b8d63aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1377f2de-939c-4ea3-8f25-981d7b8d63aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Ultra-long debt debut** : Alphabet sold a £1 billion 100-year Pounds-Sterling bond -- its first in the currency -- with strong demand from pension funds and insurers, priced at 120 basis points over UK gilts for over 6% yield.
* **Massive funding drive** : The century bond forms part of a broader $30+ billion global issuance across currencies, including debut Swiss franc bonds, to diversify sources beyond saturated USD markets.
* **AI capex explosion** : Proceeds support Alphabet's projected $185 billion capital expenditure this year, doubled for data centers and AI buildo uts amid the industry-wide hyperscaler borrowing boom.
* **Analyst caution flags** : Experts highlight "untested waters" for corporate century bonds, likening the "AI debt-fest" to past bubbles with tight spreads, uncertain long-term demand, and elevated credit risks versus sovereign debt.

# Ackman Bets Big on Undervalued Meta AI Boom
Billionaire investor **[Bill Ackman disclosed a major new stake in Meta Platforms](https://substack.com/redirect/f7412ee1-0f93-47ed-9176-76a5316bb93d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** through Pershing Square, calling the stock a "deeply discounted valuation" despite market fears over its massive $115-135 billion AI spending plans for 2026. | [](https://substack.com/redirect/f7412ee1-0f93-47ed-9176-76a5316bb93d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Major Portfolio Shift** :Pershing Square added Meta as its third new position in 2025, allocating 10% of capital in Q4 after stakes in Amazon and Hertz.
* **Valuation Comparison** : Meta trades at 22 times forward earnings, seen as cheap versus higher multiples for peers like Apple, Alphabet, and Nvidia amid expected AI-driven growth.
* **AI Spending Concerns** : Market punished Meta shares with a 16% drop over the past year due to worries over heavy AI capex, but Ackman argues fears underestimate future potential.
* **Fund Performance Boost** : Pershing Square outperformed the S&P 500 in 2025 with 20.9% net returns, and Meta's stake has gained since initiation in late November.

# McDonald's braces for the Ozempic revolution
McDonald's CEO Chris Kempczinski said the fast-food giant sees no major business hit yet from surging GLP-1 weight-loss drugs like Ozempic and Wegovy, but **[is gearing up for behavioral shifts as pill forms drive wider adoption,](https://substack.com/redirect/5cd65b7e-095c-40d2-a9b1-33d86b1f2c86?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** emphasizing protein-heavy menu strengths amid lower calorie intake.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5cd65b7e-095c-40d2-a9b1-33d86b1f2c86?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Protein Powers Strategy** : McDonald's views its chicken sandwiches and potential tenders as key strengths since GLP-1 users remain keen on high-protein options despite eating fewer calories overall.
* **Menu Experiments Underway** : Executives are testing changes around reduced snacking habits and preferences for less sugary beverages to adapt to evolving consumer choices driven by the drugs.
* **No Material Impact Yet** : The company reported strong Q4 results with 5.7% same-store sales growth beating expectations, showing resilience even as GLP-1 pill availability expands rapidly.
* **Industry Echoes Concerns** : Similar to PepsiCo's focus on portion control, McDonald's monitors broader trends where GLP-1 adoption could reshape fast-food demand and eating patterns long-term.

Caucus is one of the first real tests of strength in this election year. The earlier we know who’s with us, the better prepared we’ll be to win. Caucus is how we get Jena on the ballot, and we need your help!
If you haven’t signed up yet, please take a moment today. It really matters. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/rLuIVUXy80-xxMPfbrB89g2]

Next month, Coloradans across the state will caucus, and I want to be very clear about why that matters so much for this campaign.
Caucus is where grassroots campaigns win. It’s where neighbors show up, organize, and decide what kind of leadership they want for Colorado’s future. If we want to win this race, we have to be ready. Caucus is how we’ll get on the ballot!
That starts with you signing up to caucus for our campaign.
When you sign up:
* You help us build strength in every corner of the state
* You make sure our supporters are organized and counted
* You help us show that protecting democracy, reproductive freedom, and the rule of law is a winning message in Colorado
Please take a moment today to sign up to caucus for our campaign today! [https://secure.ngpvan.com/rLuIVUXy80-xxMPfbrB89g2]
SIGN UP [https://secure.ngpvan.com/rLuIVUXy80-xxMPfbrB89g2]It’s one of the most important things you can do between now and next month, and it truly makes a difference.
Thank you for being part of this fight and for standing with me.
Jena

Peter,

ICE is ramping up raids, detentions, and intimidation across the country.
Families are being torn apart and whole communities are living in fear.

And the leaders who refuse to stay silent about it? They’re being targeted
too.

Alexandria, Ayanna, Ilhan, and Rashida are facing a surge of racist
threats, harassment, and violent rhetoric — not just against them, but
against their families, their staff, and the communities they fight for
every single day.

This is what happens when you challenge powerful systems.

When the Squad calls out ICE abuses, demands accountability, and stands
with immigrant families, the backlash comes fast. Hate gets louder.
Threats get more explicit. And now, the risk has become real enough that
they’re forced to spend valuable resources just to keep themselves and
their staff safe.

That’s time and money that should be going toward organizing, legislating,
and building the kind of people-powered movement our communities deserve.

The Squad refuses to be intimidated. They’re showing up, telling the
truth, and fighting authoritarian power — because backing down has never
been an option when people’s lives are on the line.

But they can’t do it without the support of this grassroots team. Your
contribution helps make sure the Squad can stay safe and stay focused on
the work — standing up to ICE, defending our neighbors, and building
collective power from the ground up.

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | | | | Something extraordinary happened just 24 hours after Trump returned to office... | | Friend, this is not hyperbole. It’s a wake-up call.

**Yesterday, the SAVE Act, also known as the SAVE America Act, passed the U.S. House and now heads to the U.S. Senate. At its core, the SAVE Act is an attack on voting rights that would disenfranchise millions of eligible American citizens by imposing extreme documentation requirements on the voter registration process, target election officials, and eliminate or upend most methods of voter registration.**

This bill would not only require every American to provide documentary proof of citizenship to register to vote (passport or birth certificate), but **would also effectively eliminate NPPEF’s voter registration program.**

The SAVE Act requires voters to present citizenship documents in person to an election official in order to register to vote. Yet the majority of Pennsylvania registrations took place outside an election office in 2024 – by mail, online, at registration drives, and at state agencies. Many of those options would be nullified under the SAVE Act. **If the bill becomes law, the convenient, secure voter registration methods used by millions of Pennsylvania voters would no longer exist.**

**In the month of January, of those who answered the phone, 38% said they would have never registered to vote had they not seen NPPEF teams on the ground. _That’s 1 in 3 people we helped get registered to vote._ If the SAVE Act passes the U.S. Senate and becomes law, NPPEF would not be on the ground assisting our centered communities in registering to vote.**

A message from NPPEF’s CEO, Kadida Kenner, about the SAVE Act:
_“This message is important because I too believe in the need for voter ID.

This new iteration of the SAVE Act is not about support for voter ID. WE ALREADY have voter ID laws on the books in PA. They’re effective. Only citizens are voting. Period. This new version is about wiping out opportunities for vulnerable and historically disenfranchised qualified citizens to get registered to vote, and then also cast a ballot.

This is about voter suppression and poll taxes! We must stop it!”_
[**As a voting rights organization, NPPEF continues to vehemently oppose any type of voter suppression, including additional barriers that prevent Pennsylvanians and Americans from accessing the ballot. We should be protecting the right to vote, not restricting it. Voter Action Project[https://voteractionproject.org/]
The Senate is standing up to stop the SAVE Act in its tracks, folks.
Defenders of voting rights know that non-citizen voting is already illegal, extremely rare, and that this bill is written in a way that could disenfranchise millions of eligible women across the country. Here's Colorado Senator Michael Bennet:
(Image of Michael Bennet speaking on the Senate floor) [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/EA/EA007/1/89215/images/SAVE_MB.jpg]
Opponents of voting rights in Congress -- and in the White House -- favor this bill because they know it could suppress millions of eligible voters, changing the composition of the electorate and potentially empowering them and their party for years to come.
Please, Team, join these brave Senators today. Fuel our efforts to stop this dangerous legislation with $25 or whatever you can and ensure millions of women's voices continue to be heard in our elections >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=123025_3&amount=25]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=123025_3&amount=15] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=123025_3&amount=25] GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=123025_3&amount=50]

We know the SAVE Act was fast-tracked by opponents of voting rights to be in place before the next election, folks. This bill is a stunning assault on our fundamental right to vote, and we can not afford to let this anti-democratic legislation become law.
If you missed it: This bill would force every voter to present proof of citizenship to register, either a passport or a birth certificate that matches their current first and last name -- something millions of eligible American women don’t have. And that’s the point.
The bill would also obliterate popular methods of voter registration for all voters, including:
* Registration by mail

* 3rd party voter registration drives

* Online voter registration in states that allow it

* Automatic voter registration
Some estimates say that this bill could disenfranchise anywhere from 11 million to 65 million eligible Americans , especially women and those who live in under-resourced communities.
“ There’s never been an attack on voting rights out of Congress like this ,” said Alexander Keyssar, a professor of History and Social Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School, and a leading historian of voting rights. “ It’s always been the federal government trying to keep states in check on voting rights, for the most part. ”
The consequences of a bill like this passing would be simply catastrophic for our democracy. Chip in with $25 or whatever you can today to stop the SAVE Act and other voter suppression bills from becoming law >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=123025_3&amount=25]

These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

As a government watchdog dedicated to exposing the underbelly of systemic corruption, I've long warned that the greatest threats to our republic come not from overt enemies but from insidious networks operating in plain sight. Recent revelations on X, from investigative journalists and citizen watchdogs, paint a damning picture of fraud, unregulated cash movements, and a sprawling nonprofit sector that functions as a shadow government. Drawing from pivotal posts--detailing Hawala money brokers, the staggering scale of Somali-linked fraud, and the trillion-dollar NGO complex--it's clear we're facing a multifaceted crisis. This isn't just about stolen tax dollars; it's about the erosion of accountability, borders, and democratic control.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oZWFydGxhbmRqb3VybmFsLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.Fyvd44vfyv9KLmPqwT3TET_jG6d0pMsYdjNJwr_qwRs?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=187774799)
First, consider the alarming mechanics of Hawala, an ancient informal value transfer system rooted in Muslim cultures, now exploited to siphon billions out of the U.S. economy.

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f2476d6d-4039-446a-88fb-4ed1bb3b3c28?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Hawala operates on an "honor system" where brokers physically mule cash across borders, bypassing formal banking channels. Imagine this: You hand $10,000 to a broker in Minneapolis to send to Somalia or Iraq. They take a cut, coordinate with a counterpart abroad, and the recipient gets the equivalent locally. Periodically, the brokers settle up among themselves, often with pallets of cash shipped internationally. This isn't folklore--it's happening at scale in America.

The diagram illustrates it perfectly: Hawaladar A receives dollars from a sender and promises delivery. Hawaladar B pays out euros or local currency to the recipient. Debts are balanced later, all off the books. Curt's @wcdipatch X post reveals we've known about this for decades, yet allowed it to flourish without oversight. Why? Because it thrives in communities with limited U.S. banking access, like Somali immigrants in Minnesota. But here's the kicker: Banks must be complicit. To amass "tons of cash" for export, these brokers withdraw massive sums, triggering no alarms? Curt points to one broker tied to a Minnesota state-chartered bank, and notes that "wiring" in Somali contexts is euphemism for Hawala. This system isn't benign; it's a pipeline for laundering defrauded American tax dollars. We've identified networks, but they're still operating. As a watchdog, I demand: Shut them down now. Every undeclared pallet undermines our financial sovereignty and funds who-knows-what abroad.

Building on this, the "cash problem" in what's being dubbed "SomaliFraud"--a scheme allegedly defrauding hundreds of millions from federal programs like child nutrition aid. The numbers are jaw-dropping: $700 million moved in two years, equating to about $1 million burned daily for 730 days. This isn't petty theft; it's an industrial operation requiring a relentless supply of physical cash. Breaking down the impossibilities: Bank branches don't have infinite vaults. Cash is ordered through Federal Reserve districts, tracked meticulously to detect anomalies. In Minnesota alone--a state with a modest banking footprint--this volume would strain logistics, from armored cars to Fed replenishment.

Pushing $1 million daily through one or two states like Minnesota and Ohio (where $130 million reportedly flowed to MN) would create glaring patterns. Compliance teams, BSA/AML systems, airports, and interstate agencies would flag it. Repetition is the enemy of fraudsters--yet this ran unchecked for years. Curt's analysis concludes it must involve a multi-state network, at least 5-8 states, to dilute the signal. Rotate banks, geographies, and Fed districts to make the flow "background noise." This redundancy ensures continuity, avoiding hotspots that trigger investigations. It's sophisticated, implying insiders in banking and possibly government. Tie this back to Hawala: These fraud proceeds aren't wired; they're muled out via brokers. Airports see declarations, but declarations create trails--unless the system is rigged to ignore them. We've seen reports of couriers flying with $250,000 suitcases from Phoenix, claiming family remittances to Sudan and Somalia via Dubai. If this is "registered," who's registering? The implications are profound: Our tax system is being systematically extracted, with banks complicit and regulators asleep. This isn't just Minnesota's problem; it's a national security breach.

Now, zoom out to the revelation, an explosive X article by [@DefiyantlyFree](https://substack.com/redirect/a4c6dfb7-0e21-4c0a-b6a0-a85b12912ecb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (known as Insurrection Barbie), which frames these frauds within a broader "NGO complex" acting as a shadow government. Titled "The NGO Empire: $14.1 Trillion in the Shadows," the piece argues that nonprofits have amassed $14.1 trillion in assets--more than many nations' GDPs--while wielding unelected power. Zero votes, no oversight, yet they shape policy on immigration, aid, and social services. Funded by government grants (your taxes) and elite donors, these entities enforce ideologies without accountability. As one commenter put it: "This isn't charity; it's a shadow government... enforced through NGOs that answer to no one but donors and ideology.

"Connect the dots: In SomaliFraud, NGOs and nonprofits often administer the defrauded programs--daycares, food aid, refugee services. Minnesota's scandals involve entities like Feeding Our Future, an NGO indicted for siphoning $250 million in COVID-era child nutrition funds. These "nonprofits" receive billions in federal dollars, distribute them with minimal scrutiny, and enable cash conversion for export via Hawala. The article calls for audits, defunding, and dismantling: If an NGO takes government money, it's not "non-governmental"--treat it as a contractor with full transparency. Dark money flows in, influence flows out, eroding sovereignty. Think George Soros-funded groups pushing open borders, or Qatar-linked investors allegedly tied to riots and real estate grabs (as speculated in related threads). This complex launders not just cash but power, turning republics into oligarchies via paperwork.

Together, these posts reveal a symbiotic monster: Fraud schemes generate illicit cash, Hawala exports it undetected, and the NGO empire provides the facade of legitimacy. Somali communities, brought in via refugee programs run by NGOs, become hubs for exploitation. Banks facilitate withdrawals, airports wave through couriers, and regulators look away. The cost? Billions (Trillions?) in stolen taxes, weakened borders, and funded extremism abroad. It's not red vs. blue--Ohio's involvement proves that. It's about hiding in plain sight.

Just in the last two years, cash went through the Minneapolis airport, headed for Somali. And as early as 2018 a local news outlet has noticed $100 million a year was sent out through that airport. A former TSA agent in Minneapolis alleges that Somalis were waived through airport security with suitcases full of cash and passports. Minneapolis-St. Paul International Airport is staffed by many Somalis in the area. Records show Minneapolis Airport TSA staff is 98% Somali, including airport managers, staff and ground crew boss. It goes deep.

As a watchdog, I urge immediate action: President Trump and DOGE must prioritize a full audit of NGOs receiving federal funds. St. Paul Airport is a national security threat. You can carry any amount of cash on a plane internationally, but you must declare any amount exceeding $10,000, enforce that. Tax remittences. Ban Hawala operations are lacking stringent oversight. Expand investigations to 5-8 states, subpoena banks, and track cash flows.

Prosecute enablers, from brokers to complicit officials. Reclaim the $14.1 trillion shadow economy--tax it, regulate it, or dissolve it. Citizens, demand transparency: Contact your reps, support journalists like Barbie and Curt. This rot festers because we allow it. Expose it, excise it, or watch our republic dissolve not in fire, but in untraceable cash and unchecked power.

Peter,

I have a proposal for the outgoing failed Governor of California.

He says he's fixed the homeless issue.

Okay, then he should walk Skid Row with me in LA. I'll show him the homeless crisis firsthand, and he can explain where the billions of dollars he said would end homelessness have gone.

He shouldn't be scared. I'm a Sheriff and will protect him.

[](https://links.trueamericanconservatives.com/s/c/J4T1gSLVBKi4NwjA5ZMv8xFX6hDcaiITXtg7G9ghpDj6liEyyq0AloHpQuA_xlknbocFnvNdZsbDVcZh2ubRgGDYwQe2UBECOm4DHZp_AFz9wBzCP9_O2pH1-pToVtAQQv7e9nM_Ke2H4y2tWvQt9TcbSoiEJH8GzN4IkIlP9r2zuLxxxIaNX6NyuK2onRY4JhJBs2AjhiKkTHa2Qw5OuBhTqNv491BLdgl5jqdecxK_scMvhuWse_5wEkJAkVyn76j4cv4Iq7fng3t9sGunJMXRkLYOipo09l0Pa9JzCkBnSgy6F_XuH5viwEUEGrsriO8tPEv4OfhVo7tfVIktkmihmM-mqKhY1gqSnZF4YrzA48uQJS25XxzZ6DVlvPwd4D4FNCcJIQGIA3raS5Zd0c2SDtk17oslWnqqoCk6WWU-xazb848KRCDz40s-e_ltdnjsYZsf88wvmcjw01_9wZy-kwILhswjOzkFAAeIbNZD4qtqcuMaY67sKUvPk8Md3D1aEMgPvToxlsNfLQ/plwd1mNYuiIAEyKzsBTCj-Sm0DdSJuLR/17)

Sadly, though, we know he won't show up. Neither will any Democrat running for Governor.

They won't face the reality of what THEIR policies have done to our great cities. Instead, they hide behind armed guards and press releases.

**I want to solve the problem. Together, we will solve the problem.**
